jobs.title: Senior Machine Learning Graphics Engineer, AI for Experiences
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

NVIDIA is searching for a world-class engineer in graphics and AI to join our neural graphics product team. If you agree with us that the most exciting thing about the AI revolution is applying it to solve real problems, this team will be an excellent fit for you! We are passionate about applications in generative AI, gaming, augmented reality, user-generated content, computer vision, and other areas, with the goal of improving visual fidelity, gameplay, or other domains within the gaming and pro-visualization markets. Working with other teams throughout the company, you will productize promising research, as well as develop new features through your own work.

What You'll Be Doing

Use AI for solving product problems in gaming and other interactive experiences.
Build upon the latest research to create new models and invent new ways of applying AI to advance neural graphics and gaming.
Create prototypes to demonstrate real-life applications of your ideas and to accelerate productization.
Keep up with the latest AI/DL research and collaborate with diverse teams (both internal and external to NVIDIA), including AI/DL researchers, hardware architects, and software engineers.
Participate in technology transfers to and from teams across NVIDIA.

What We Need To See

Master's in computer science/engineering, Machine Learning, AI, and related fields (or equivalent experience)
8+ years of machine learning / deep learning research or work experience
Knowledge of application areas such as real-time computer graphics, CV, and game development.
Expertise with programming systems such as Python, C+, CUDA, and deep learning frameworks such as TensorFlow and PyTorch. Very strong programming skills.
A proven track record of delivering complex products and technologies spanning multiple teams and functional areas.

Intelligent machines powered by AI computers that can learn, reason, and interact with people are no longer science fiction. Image recognition and speech recognition — GPU deep learning has provided the foundation for machines to learn, perceive, reason, and solve problems. The GPU started out as the engine for simulating human imagination, conjuring up the amazing virtual worlds of video games and Hollywood films. Now, NVIDIA's GPU runs deep learning algorithms, simulating human intelligence, and acts as the brain of computers, robots and self-driving cars that can perceive and understand the world. Just as human imagination and intelligence are linked, computer graphics and artificial intelligence come together in our architecture. Two modes of the human brain, two modes of the GPU. This may explain why NVIDIA GPUs are used broadly for deep learning, and NVIDIA is known as “the AI computing company.”

Widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers, NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. As you plan your future, see what we can offer to you and your family www.nvidiabenefits.com

Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and other objective job-related factors. The expected base salary ranges for this position are:

183,750 USD – 351,000 USD for Level 4; and 225,000 USD – 429,000 USD for Level 5.

You will also be eligible for equity and benefits.

Applications for this job will be accepted at least until November 20, 2026.

This posting is for an existing vacancy.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Algorithm
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Principal Recommendation Algorithm Engineer, you will be responsible for personalized recommendations across the trading products, content, and community. You will understand how user behavior evolves across scenarios; model cross-scenario behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent; and jointly optimize objectives such as clicks, conversions, and retention to improve recommendation performance and user experience.
You will work closely with recommendation engineering, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available personalization system serving more than 80 million users globally. You will drive technical advances in personalized recommendations, distribution strategies, user understanding, and content understanding.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and improve recommendation models for the trading products, content, and community. Use large-scale user behavior data to model user interests accurately and improve recommendation performance and user experience.
Explore cross-domain transfer and cold-start optimization across business scenarios, taking each scenario's characteristics into account to improve cross-scenario recommendation results and cold-start coverage.
Optimize multi-objective ranking models for CTR, CVR, LTV, and other outcomes. Design mechanisms for combining ranking objectives and balance clicks, conversions, and long-term value under scenario-specific constraints.
Model cross-scenario user behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent. Develop reusable user representations to address scenario transfer, sparse feedback, and cold-start challenges.
Explore generative recommendation approaches, including semantic IDs and generative candidate generation, and integrate generative methods with discriminative recommendation pipelines.

Major Requirements

At least 4 years of experience developing search, advertising, or recommendation algorithms at a consumer-facing internet company, with a deep understanding of retrieval, ranking, and multi-objective modeling.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Python, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging problems.
Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities in data.
An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to approach challenging problems with clarity and sound reasoning.
Good business judgment and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate on and solve business problems.

Nice-to-have:

Search, advertising, or recommendation algorithm experience at major technology companies
Experience with multi-objective modeling, short- and long-term user sequence modeling, personalized uplift modeling, or generative modeling.
Publications at leading international conferences, including but not limited to KDD, SIGIR, RecSys, ACL, or NeurIPS.
An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.

Why Join Us

A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:
Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows.
Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:
Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade.
Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:
Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering.
An opportunity to lead, not just follow:
Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration.
Global scale:
Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

jobs.title: Founding AI Engineer
jobs.description:
About Us

Coach is building the AI coach for the physical world. Starting with in-person sales.

For centuries, field organizations have relied on layers of management to relay information, coach teams, and understand performance. We believe AI will radically change how these companies operate and how people learn and improve at work.

Today, understanding why a sales rep succeeds or struggles still requires being alongside them in the field. That doesn’t scale. And yet roughly 80% of global sales still happen offline.

Coach helps employees learn faster, improve, and close more. Managers get a clear view of what’s happening, where people need help, and why, so they can focus on solving problems.

Our custom AI harness turns field conversations and business context into sales intelligence
, grounding coaching in what actually happens on the ground. Over time, that accumulated knowledge becomes a company brain
: a shared understanding of how the business works.

We’re bringing AI to people who have never had a reason to use it, by making it part of the human interactions at the heart of their work. In-person sales is only the beginning

What you’ll own

Our AI harness. Build how agents gather context, access tools, retain knowledge, deliver and track coaching grounded in real conversations.
Evaluation and experimentation. Create datasets, benchmarks, and feedback loops to measure agent and model quality. Investigate failures, challenge apparent patterns, and test whether improvements translate into customer value.
Machine learning models. Design, train, evaluate, and deploy models for behavioral analysis, performance forecasting, and personalized coaching from dataset construction and feature engineering to validation and monitoring.
Production infrastructure. Build and operate the backend, data pipelines, and services behind Coach. Improve reliability, security, observability, latency, and cost.
Our software factory. Work with the team to build the tools, environments, and verification workflows that let our team and coding agents collaborate effectively.
Forward deploying. You will meet our customers and spend time with them to better understand how to satisfy their needs

Who you’ll work with

We're a small team in SF and Paris, growing fast. Our CTO has been building software and AI across many industries for the last 10 years. Our CEO and COO are repeat founders who built and ran in-person sales teams selling to pharmacies. We've lived the problem firsthand and built Coach to solve it.

With just two employees (Customer Success + Engineering), we took Coach to $1.5M ARR in 8 months
— and we're scaling aggressively from here.

What you bring

Strong backend engineering skills and experience shipping and operating production systems.
Hands-on experience building AI applications: context management, retrieval, tool use, orchestration, and evaluation.
Experience developing ML models on real data and taking them beyond experimentation into a usable product.
Solid foundations in probability, statistics, and machine learning. You can recognize confounding, prevent data leakage, quantify uncertainty, and choose an appropriate baseline.
Fluency in Python and SQL, and confidence working with cloud infrastructure.
An AI-native approach to development, with the judgment to understand and verify what your tools produce.
Curiosity about the people using your work, and the ability to turn an ambiguous business problem into a focused implementation.

We're not hiring for a title or a number of years. We're hiring for what you can build. Whether you've done this for 2 years or 10, if you've shipped real AI systems into production and can turn an ambiguous business problem into a working product, we want to talk.

Our current stack

Backend: Python, FastAPI, Pydantic.
Agent systems: a custom harness built with PydanticAI and frontier model APIs.
Data: PostgreSQL and Supabase.
Infrastructure: Google Cloud Run, Cloud Tasks, Docker, and GitHub Actions.
AI evaluation and observability: Braintrust.
Voice: LiveKit, Deepgram, and ElevenLabs.

You’ll help evolve this stack and select the modeling tools that fit the problems we tackle. We value strong foundations and evidence of what you’ve built; experience with every tool listed isn’t required.

SF-based, relocation supported (visa sponsorship available)

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer-ML Platform
jobs.description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.

At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.

A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.

Why User Behavior?

As a Senior Software Engineer on the User Behavior ML Platform, you will build the data and serving foundation behind Roblox's user-level safety understanding, so that every safety system can see who a user is, not just what a single piece of content looks like.

You will own the core ML platform for a new capability at Roblox: a safety user feature store, user embeddings, and risk scores that power personalized consequences, proactive detection, and early education. This is a rare opportunity to build foundational, high-scale ML systems that shape how Roblox understands and responds to risk across hundreds of millions of users.

You will feel a deep sense of responsibility building systems that directly affect millions of users, especially minors, on one of the world's largest platforms. Your work will reduce harm, improve fairness, and help ensure Roblox remains a place where creativity and community can thrive safely.

You Will

Build the Safety User Feature Store: Design and operate the pipelines that turn violations, reports, appeals, filter activity, and engagement signals into reliable, well-documented user features for training and serving.
Serve User Embeddings and Risk Scores: Take user embeddings and risk models from offline training to production, including low-latency online lookup and similar-user search for detection teams.
Build the Real-Time Path: Extend batch pipelines to streaming, so fresh behavioral signals reach models and downstream safety systems within minutes, not days.
Enable ML Teams to Move Fast: Partner with MLEs and Data Scientists to provide self-serve tooling for feature discovery, training data generation, offline evaluation, and A/B experiment hooks.
Own Data Quality and Governance: Build monitoring for feature freshness, drift, lineage, and ownership, so teams across Safety can trust and reuse signals.
Design for Trust and Auditability: Build systems that support explainability, fairness review, and appeals correction, since these signals directly shape consequences for millions of users.
Ship Code, Not Just Designs: Own end-to-end delivery, from system design through migration, testing, production operation, and oncall.

You Have

5+ years of experience building and operating production ML platforms, data infrastructure, or large-scale backend systems.
Strong experience with batch and streaming data pipelines (e.g., Spark, Flink, Kafka) feeding feature stores or similar ingestion layers.
Experience designing low-latency serving systems: service APIs (RPC/gRPC), key-value storage, caching, and high-throughput read paths.
Proficiency in Python and a statically-typed backend language (Go, Java, or similar).
Solid production operations fundamentals: monitoring, alerting, oncall, and incident response for systems with real user-facing impact.
Comfort partnering with ML engineers, with a working understanding of the model lifecycle: training data generation, offline evaluation, deployment, and drift monitoring.
Nice to have:
Experience in Trust & Safety, content moderation, user detection, or other adversarial domains
Experience with user-level modeling or user understanding
Experience with embeddings and vector similarity search in production
Familiarity with feature store platforms and signal governance
Experience building agentic workflows or tool interfaces for LLM agents (e.g., MCP)

You Are

A Systems Thinker: capable of designing platforms that ML and detection teams build on, not just point solutions.
A Pragmatic Builder: scrappy and impact-oriented, comfortable turning scattered, undocumented signals into clean, well-owned data products.
Comfortable with Ambiguity: this space is still being defined, and you will help set the standard rather than follow an existing one.
A Reliability-Minded Engineer: you treat data quality, testing, migrations, and oncall as first-class parts of the job.
A Strong Collaborator: you work effectively across ML, Policy, Product, and Detection teams, and make the people around you faster.
Committed to Ethical, Responsible Engineering: dedicated to building systems that are fair, auditable, and operate with the utmost responsibility toward user safety.

jobs.title: Machine Learning Engineer
jobs.description:
Machine Learning Engineer | AI Security & Fraud Detection

Location:
San Francisco, CA - Onsite
Compensation:
$220,000–$300,000
Experience:
3+ Years, Ideally 5+ Years
Industry:
AI Infrastructure, Agentic AI, Cybersecurity, Fraud Prevention

About the Opportunity

Shields Group Search is partnering with a well-funded, early-stage AI infrastructure startup building the trust and security layer for the rapidly emerging AI agent economy.
As AI agents increasingly act autonomously on behalf of individuals and businesses, from booking services and accessing APIs to executing financial transactions, companies need infrastructure that can determine which agents are legitimate, who they represent, what actions they're authorized to perform, and whether their behavior presents a security or fraud risk.
Our client is building real-time verification and decisioning infrastructure that enables businesses to safely interact with AI agents at scale.
The platform combines agent identity verification, behavioral intelligence, risk assessment, and security controls to distinguish legitimate automated activity from suspicious or malicious behavior.

We're looking for an exceptional Machine Learning Engineer to build the models that distinguish a trusted AI agent from an attack, in real time and under load.

This is an opportunity to join a small, highly technical founding-stage engineering team and take meaningful ownership of mission-critical ML infrastructure.
What You'll Be Working On
The models behind this platform operate directly on the production request path. They must evaluate activity and support trust decisions in real time, under the same strict latency constraints as the rest of the infrastructure.
There is no offline batch job to hide behind and no second chance if a prediction is too slow or incorrect.

You'll work on problems involving:

Real-Time Fraud & Threat Detection:
Develop ML models that identify potentially fraudulent, malicious, or unauthorized agent activity while minimizing false positives.
Behavioral & Anomaly Detection:
Identify suspicious patterns, anomalous agent interactions, and emerging risks across automated transactions and API activity.
Low-Latency ML Inference:
Build and optimize production model-serving systems capable of making accurate decisions under demanding latency and throughput requirements.
Cold-Start & Low-Label Learning:
Develop effective detection approaches when labeled examples are scarce, including unsupervised learning, weak supervision, and custom evaluation datasets.
End-to-End ML Ownership:
Build, evaluate, deploy, monitor, and continuously improve production ML systems, from data and feature pipelines through real-time serving.
Adversarial ML:
Help build systems that remain effective as malicious actors adapt their behavior to evade detection.
Agentic AI Infrastructure:
Work at the intersection of modern ML, AI agents, tool calling, identity verification, and security.

What We're Looking For

Must-Haves

3+ years of professional ML experience
, ideally 5+ years, building, evaluating, and deploying production models, not just research or notebooks.
Strong Python and a modern ML framework (PyTorch or TensorFlow); solid SQL.
Production ML systems end to end: feature pipelines, training, evaluation, and low-latency, real-time serving.
Comfort with low-label and cold-start problems, including anomaly detection, unsupervised methods, weak supervision, and building evaluation sets and labels from scratch.
Data analysis, statistics, and experiment design.
Strong software engineering. You ship versioned, testable, reproducible code, not throwaway models.
Experience working in highly technical engineering environments with strong software engineering standards.
Ability to take ownership, solve ambiguous problems, and ship production-grade solutions in a fast-moving startup environment.

Strongly Preferred

Applied ML in fraud, risk, abuse, account integrity, or security.
Experience building ML models for fraud prevention, threat detection, trust and safety, or other systems designed to prevent malicious activity.
Graph ML / GNNs, sequence or behavioral modeling, or anomaly detection.
LLM / NLP work, and familiarity with AI agents, including tool use, function calling, and MCP.
Experience in adversarial settings, where the threat evolves against the model.
Explainable, auditable, reproducible ML, with real model versioning.
Experience developing ML systems at highly technical, engineering-driven companies, particularly those working on large-scale infrastructure, payments, fraud prevention, cybersecurity, or AI platforms.

Bonus Qualifications

Payment protocols (x402), agent identity (DID / VC), or crypto commitments (Merkle anchoring).
Experience at an early-stage startup or building ML infrastructure from the ground up.
Familiarity with real-time transaction monitoring, behavioral risk scoring, or identity verification systems.

Compensation & Work Arrangement

Base Salary:
$220,000–$300,000
Equity:
Competitive equity participation in an early-stage, venture-backed company.
Location:
San Francisco, CA.
Work Arrangement:
The team strongly prefers engineers working onsite five days per week. Hybrid flexibility may be considered for exceptional candidates who can regularly collaborate in person.

The team is hiring immediately and can move quickly for the right individual.

jobs.description:
Position Overview:

Many of Intapp's internal business processes still run on manual steps, and the work is slow, inconsistent, and hard to scale. As a Senior AI Engineer, you will build the agentic workflows that replace those steps, working directly with the business teams who depend on them. You will ship real applications that people can use and give feedback on, so each workflow gets better over time. The team also partners with the product organization on Intapp Celeste, a major current focus.

Day to day, you will turn loosely described business needs into working software: designing agent workflows, writing production Python, integrating with internal systems, and putting evaluation, guardrails, and monitoring around everything you ship. All of your stakeholders are internal, and most can't yet describe their requirements in technical terms, so you will need strong software engineering skills and the judgment to turn ambiguity into something concrete. You will work with Python, LLM APIs, Model Context Protocol (MCP), and cloud services.

What you will do:

As a Senior AI Engineer, you can expect to:

Design, build, and deploy agentic workflows that automate manual, slow business processes, delivered as applications that business teams can use, give feedback on, and see improve over time.

Work with internal stakeholders to turn loosely described needs into clear requirements, agree on outcomes, and deliver in small, visible steps.

Build MCP servers and integrations that give agents governed access to internal systems and data, with consistent patterns for authentication, access control, and auditability.

Put evaluation, observability, and guardrails around every workflow in production, and test new AI techniques so only the ones that matter reach the business.

Partner with the product organization to manage certain pieces of Intapp's own Celeste instance and answer internal users' questions about it.

What you will need:

Intapp is looking for intellectually curious, self-motivated professionals who like to get hands-on to contribute to the overall success of the business and their team. To apply for this Senior AI Engineer role, you will ideally have:

Deep Python and core software engineering skills, including production-quality services and automation with solid testing, typing, and design.

Hands-on experience building and deploying LLM-based applications or agentic workflows, including orchestration, tool calling, evaluation, and monitoring.

Practical knowledge of MCP or similar tool interfaces for LLMs, and experience integrating securely with internal systems and APIs.

The ability to translate ambiguous business needs into working solutions and to communicate clearly with non-technical stakeholders.

Sound judgment about which AI patterns are useful and which are hype, with a bias toward shipping small, working increments and acting on user feedback.

Experience deploying services in the cloud (AWS preferred) with Git and CI/CD, plus working SQL for integrating with business data.

At Intapp, you’ll get the opportunity to bring your talents and intellectual curiosity to create better outcomes for our people and our clients. Expand Your Skills: Unlock your potential with professional development opportunities supported by a community of experienced professionals. We offer reimbursement for training and continuing education to help you stay ahead in your career.

Enjoy Where You Work: Thrive in our modern, open offices designed to inspire creativity and collaboration. Our complimentary lunches and fully stocked kitchens ensure you have everything you need to stay energized throughout the day.

Join us and be a part of a collaborative and welcoming culture where your contributions are valued, and your professional growth is a priority. Together, we are building a company of long-term value that we can all be proud of.

jobs.title: Applied Research Scientist, Manufacturing
jobs.description:
About Lumafield: 

Lumafield was founded in 2019 to upgrade manufacturing.

We are engineers with deep experience across the product development cycle, from initial ideas to shipping hardware, across industries and specializations, who became frustrated by the cost and complexity of modern manufacturing. So we decided to upgrade it.

Engineers make million-dollar decisions every day, and they need tools that give them the greatest possible insight into their products. By offering unprecedented visibility into products, as well as AI-driven tools that highlight problems and generate quantitative data, Lumafield promises to revolutionize the way complex products are created, manufactured, and used across industries. We started with industrial CT scanning, which for us was the most valuable but underutilized tool in the manufacturing toolbox, enabling us to rapidly inspect essential components non-destructively.

We rebuilt the whole system, from X-ray capture, to computer vision analysis, to web-based collaboration, to the entire business model, making the most advanced manufacturing tech more accessible to every industry. Our company, like our platform, is designed for upgrades. We’re building for greater intelligence, autonomy, and speed. For deeper vision, operational excellence, and powerful insights. And then we'll upgrade it all again.

jobs.title: ML Infra Engineer, Compute
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Physical Intelligence is bringing general-purpose AI into the physical world. We are a group of engineers, scientists, roboticists, and company builders developing foundation models and learning algorithms to power the robots of today and the physically-actuated devices of the future.

The Team

The ML Infrastructure team supports and accelerates PI’s core modeling efforts by building the systems that make large-scale training reliable, reproducible, and fast. You will work closely with ML Infra (training systems), data platform, and research teams to ensure compute scheduling is never the bottleneck.

About The Role

Physical Intelligence builds general-purpose AI for the physical world. Training our models requires orchestrating thousands of accelerators across a heterogeneous fleet of GPU and TPU clusters — spanning different hardware generations, cloud providers, and cluster topologies.

Today, researchers often need to know which cluster to target, what resources are available, and how to configure their jobs accordingly. That doesn't scale. We need a scheduling and compute layer that makes the right placement decision automatically — routing jobs to the best cluster based on availability, hardware fit, cost, and priority — so researchers can focus entirely on the science.

This role owns that problem end-to-end: the scheduling systems, the placement logic, the cluster management layer, and the operational tooling that keeps it all running.

This is not cloud DevOps. It's not about standing up clusters and walking away. It's a systems role for people who care about intelligent resource allocation, utilization, fault tolerance, and making large-scale distributed training seamless.

In This Role You Will

Own Intelligent Job Scheduling and Placement: Design and build multi-tenant scheduling systems that automatically place training jobs on the best available cluster based on hardware requirements, topology, availability, cost, and priority. Support fair resource sharing across teams and projects with quota management, priority tiers, and preemption policies. Abstract away cluster differences so researchers submit jobs without needing to know where they will land.
Scale Multi-cluster Orchestration: Build the control plane that manages the job lifecycle across diverse clusters (mixed GPU/TPU, multi-generation hardware, on-prem/cloud) and enables seamless job migration, failover, and re-scheduling.
Optimize Accelerator Utilization and Efficiency: Monitor and optimize GPU/TPU utilization across the entire fleet. Implement priority, preemption, queueing, and fairness policies that balance research velocity with cost efficiency.
Ensure Scaling and Stability: Implement fault detection, automatic recovery, and resilience for long-running multi-node training jobs. Manage health checking, node management, and scaling to thousands of accelerators.
Support Inference and Robot Deployment: Extend scheduling and orchestration to inference workloads, including deploying models to edge devices on physical robots.
Enhance Observability and Developer Experience: Build the dashboards, alerting, SLOs, and debugging tools necessary for researchers to understand job status and for the team to ensure high scheduling quality and cluster reliability.

What We Hope You'll Bring

We’re intentionally flexible on exact background, but strong candidates usually have:

Strong software engineering fundamentals
Experience building or operating job scheduling / resource management systems at scale
Experience with large-scale compute clusters (GPU and/or TPU)
Familiarity with schedulers and orchestration systems (SLURM, Kubernetes, GKE, K3S, or internal equivalents)
Comfort reasoning about resource allocation, bin-packing, priority scheduling, and multi-tenancy
Understanding of how ML training workloads behave — long-running, multi-node, sensitive to stragglers, topology-dependent
A bias toward owning systems end-to-end, from design to operation
Enjoy working closely with researchers and unblocking fast-moving projects

Bonus Points

Experience building multi-cluster or federated scheduling systems
Experience with TPU infrastructure (GCP TPU slices, Multislice, GKE)
Background in cluster resource managers (Borg, YARN, Mesos, or custom schedulers)
Linux systems engineering, networking, and infrastructure-as-code
NCCL/collective communication and topology-aware placement
Experience with capacity planning and cloud cost optimization at scale
Familiarity with JAX, PyTorch, or similar ML frameworks at the runtime/systems level

jobs.title: Founding Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
About Skiffra

Skiffra is building the intelligence layer for operational decision-making in physical industries.

We're developing AI-native orchestration systems that turn complex, high-stakes operations into intelligent, adaptive workflows. We're starting with mining and natural resources, where decisions move people, equipment and capital, and where the consequences of getting them wrong are real.

Our ambition extends well beyond mining. We're building a platform designed to change how physical industries make decisions.

The Role

As a Forward-Deployed Engineer at Skiffra, you will work directly with customers to turn difficult operational problems into working deployments of our platform. You will spend real time on site with operators, business leaders, and technical teams, learning how their systems and workflows actually function and determining how Skiffra can improve them.

You will own the technical path from discovery through deployment: understanding the problem, designing the solution, integrating customer systems and data, configuring the platform, validating the result with users, and getting it into reliable operation. You will also identify where the platform needs to evolve and translate field evidence into precise requirements that Skiffra’s product and engineering team can act on.

This is a founding-stage role for someone who combines technical depth with business judgment. You should care as much about whether a solution changes an important operating outcome as whether the architecture is sound. Skiffra's platform is rapidly evolving, and your work in the field will help determine how it becomes broadly useful across customers and industries.

This person will be based in Los Angeles or the San Francisco Bay Area, with a preference for Los Angeles and will be required to travel up to 30-50%.

What You’ll Do

Embed with customer teams to understand their operations, systems, data, constraints, and most consequential problems
Understand the operational and economic significance of the problem, including the effect on throughput, cost, reliability, risk, or time
Turn ambiguous customer needs into clear technical problems, solution designs, deployment plans, and measures of success
Design integrations across customer systems, APIs, databases, identity systems, ERP platforms, historians, and other operational technology
Configure and deploy the Skiffra platform in customer environments, including data mapping, workflow setup, testing, validation, and production readiness
Diagnose technical problems across Skiffra, customer systems, data pipelines, infrastructure, permissions, and third-party services
Work directly with operators and business leaders to ensure the deployed solution reflects how the operation works and improves a meaningful outcome
Partner closely with product and platform engineers through implementation, then validate that what ships works under real operating conditions
Identify missing platform capabilities and distinguish customer-specific requests from recurring patterns that should become reusable platform capabilities
Translate those findings into clear, evidence-based requirements for Skiffra’s product and engineering team
Document deployment patterns and help build the methods, tools, and playbooks that make future deployments faster and more repeatable

What We’re Looking For

At least four years of relevant experience in software, data engineering, systems integration, enterprise technology, technology startups, technical consulting, or a similarly demanding client-facing environment
Experience leading ambiguous customer-facing technical work from discovery through a deployed outcome
The judgment and communication skills to earn credibility with customer executives, IT teams, frontline operators, and Skiffra’s product and engineering teams
Strong computer science fundamentals and the ability to reason clearly about systems, data models, APIs, infrastructure, security, and technical tradeoffs
Experience working with data and integrations using tools such as SQL, Python, APIs, cloud services, or enterprise platforms
The judgment to connect technical decisions to customer operations and business outcomes, rather than treating the requested feature as the whole problem
High ownership and comfort working through ambiguity, incomplete information, and unfamiliar operating environments
An AI-native working style: you use modern AI tools fluently to investigate, analyze, document, and move faster while maintaining judgment and accuracy
Willingness to travel up to 50% and spend meaningful time at customer sites, including industrial and remote locations
Ability to work from Los Angeles or San Francisco

Nice to Have

Experience identifying follow-on customer opportunities from successful deployment outcomes.
Experience deploying enterprise software directly with customers
Experience turning recurring customer needs into reusable product capabilities
Experience with ERP, historian, maintenance, or operational systems such as SAP, PI, or Wonderware
Experience navigating enterprise security, identity, networking, cloud, or on-premises infrastructure
Exposure to industrial, mining, manufacturing, energy, logistics, or other heavy-asset operating environments
French language fluency

How We Work

We value speed, clarity, and technical rigor. We favor simple systems over clever ones, prototypes over over-planning, and ownership over handoffs. You’ll work directly with founders and ship things that matter quickly.

Location & Work Model

This is a hybrid role requiring regular in-person collaboration at the designated office location, as specified in the job posting (Los Angeles, San Francisco, Montreal, or Brisbane). We are not a fully remote company.

Work Authorization

Candidates must be authorized to work in the country where this role is based. Visa sponsorship is not available for this position.

Benefits & Eligibility

This position is eligible for Skiffra’s standard benefits, including health insurance and retirement plans, and may also qualify for participation in the Company’s bonus and incentive programs.

Equal Opportunity

Skiffra is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency and accuracy of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. Experience with deep learning/modern ML techniques

About the Role

As a Principal Recommendation System/Platform Engineer, you will lead the upgrade of our core recommendation architecture and recommendation model platform, transforming our existing rule-based personalization system into an industrial-grade, large-scale, real-time ML recommendation platform. This role spans key business scenarios, including trading products, content feeds, the community, and AI-powered investment workflows such as TradeGPT.
You will work closely with recommendation algorithm, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available foundation for personalization at scale, serving more than 80 million users globally. You will lead architectural decisions, infrastructure development, and end-to-end delivery, taking the platform from zero to one in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Develop high-throughput, low-latency recommendation services. Continuously improve system performance and reliability, and establish robust degradation and disaster-recovery mechanisms.
Build and optimize large-scale model training infrastructure, including distributed training, job scheduling, resource management, fault recovery, and training observability. Improve training efficiency, stability, and resource utilization.
Build model deployment capabilities and high-performance online inference services. Optimize model loading, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost; implement autoscaling, canary releases, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery to ensure service availability under high traffic.
Establish an engineering feedback loop from offline evaluation and online experimentation to production monitoring. Monitor model quality, service performance, and anomalies; build alerting capabilities to support incident diagnosis and safe rollback.
Collaborate with recommendation algorithm and business engineering teams to identify common needs across trading products, content feeds, community, and other recommendation scenarios. Standardize training, deployment, and inference capabilities to bring models into production reliably and efficiently.

Major Requirements

At least 4 years of recommender systems engineering experience at a consumer-facing internet company. You have contributed substantially to the design and development of a model training platform, model deployment platform, or large-scale online inference service, and have hands-on experience resolving production issues.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging engineering problems.
Familiarity with at least one mainstream deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. You understand the end-to-end workflow of training, exporting, deploying, and serving recommendation models, and have practical experience with distributed training or training job orchestration.
An understanding of the recommendation system lifecycle and the engineering considerations involved in sequence models, multi-objective models, and other recommender model types. You can work with algorithm teams to turn model requirements into reusable, maintainable production platform capabilities.
Experience designing and optimizing high-throughput, low-latency services. You can diagnose and resolve online inference issues involving throughput, P99 latency, reliability, and resource cost.

Nice-to-have:

Architecture experience in search, advertising, or recommendations at major technology companies
Experience leading the development of a training platform, model deployment platform, or online inference pipeline from the ground up in a large-scale recommendation, advertising, or search system, and making those capabilities reusable across business scenarios.
Experience optimizing distributed training or inference for complex recommendation models, or scheduling heterogeneous CPU/GPU resources.
Experience with cross-region high-availability deployments, active-active architectures, model release governance, or large-scale production incident response.
An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.

Why Join Us

A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:
Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows.
Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:
Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade.
Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:
Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering.
An opportunity to lead, not just follow:
Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration.
Global scale:

In this role, you will architect scalable partner-facing tools and internal automation systems that allow NVIDIA to deliver technical education at scale through a growing network of Authorized Learning Partners (ALPs) worldwide. Day to day you will build and run the Kubernetes and AWS infrastructure behind our GPU-accelerated lab environments - reducing manual effort, enabling self-service, and keeping the platform reliable and secure as demand grows.

NVIDIA is an industry leader with groundbreaking developments in HPC, Artificial Intelligence, and accelerated computing. The GPU, our invention, serves as the visual cortex of modern computers and is at the heart of our products and services. Our work opens new universes to explore, enables outstanding creativity and discovery, and powers what were once science fiction inventions -- from artificial intelligence to autonomous vehicles. We invite you to join a small, high-impact team and partner closely with our technical leads to build platforms that bring NVIDIA education to the world - combining deep Kubernetes and AWS expertise with pragmatic automation to create systems that scale our reach, empower our partners, and continuously raise the bar on technical training quality.

Agentic Education Systems: Develop AI-powered agentic workflows that bring intelligence to the education lifecycle - from adaptive learning path recommendations to intelligent scheduling, proactive recertification alerts, and AI-assisted quality assessment of instructors and learners.
Lab Environment & Training Infrastructure: Design, build, and operate the cloud infrastructure that delivers GPU-accelerated lab environments for ILT and self-paced courses at scale.
Partner Platform Development: Build a platform that enables partners to self-manage onboarding, certification tracking, course access, and performance reporting - reducing operational overhead while scaling partner reach globally.

Staff API Solutions Architect – B2B & Platform Integrations (Hybrid in South San Francisco)

About The Role

We are seeking a Senior/Staff API Solutions Architect to join Twist Bioscience's Information and Business Technology (IBT) organization to design and scale API integrations that make it easier for customers to do business with Twist. This is a technical, externally facing role that works at the intersection of customers, strategic platform partners, Product, and Engineering. You will be responsible for architecting API-based solutions that enable customers to seamlessly integrate their systems with Twist, as well as developing integrations with third-party platforms where customers can discover, configure, and place orders with Twist directly within those platforms.

The role will focus on three key integration models:

Direct Customer API Integrations: Partner with enterprise customers and their technical teams to design and implement integrations that enable them to place orders,

retrieve order information, and interact with Twist's services directly through their internal systems.

Third-Party Platform Integrations: Collaborate with external technology and platform partners to design and build API integrations that enable customers to transact with

Twist through third-party platforms. This includes understanding the platform's architecture, defining integration requirements, mapping data and workflows, and

working with internal and external engineering teams to deliver scalable solutions.

AI-Enabled & MCP Integrations: Explore and design integrations leveraging Model Context Protocol (MCP) and emerging AI technologies to enable customers and partner

platforms to interact with Twist's products and services through AI assistants, agents, and intelligent workflows. Work with internal and external teams to define how Twist's APIs can be securely exposed and consumed through MCP-enabled experiences.

We are looking for someone who combines strong API architecture and integration expertise with the ability to work directly with customers and technology partners. The ideal candidate is comfortable leading technical discovery, defining solution architectures, troubleshooting complex integrations, and working hands-on with APIs and code when needed.

What You’ll Be Doing

Lead the technical discovery, solution design, and architecture of API integrations for both direct enterprise customers and third-party platforms. Define scalable, secure, and

maintainable integration patterns that align with Twist's API capabilities and business needs.

Evaluate and design MCP-based integrations that enable AI assistants, agents, and third-party platforms to securely interact with Twist's APIs.
Work directly with external platform partners and customers and their engineering teams to design integrations that allow customers to discover, configure, and order Twist products. Collaborate on API specifications, data models, workflow orchestration, authentication, and integration architecture.
Serve as the lead throughout the integration lifecycle, from discovery and architecture through development, testing, launch, and post-launch support. Work closely with

internal and external engineering teams to resolve technical challenges and ensure successful implementation.

Investigate complex API and integration issues, analyze payloads and logs, and troubleshoot data and workflow discrepancies.
Provide insights from customer and platform integrations to help influence Twist's API roadmap, identify opportunities for reusable capabilities, and reduce the need for

customer-specific customizations.

Stay current with emerging API, MCP, and agentic AI integration standards. Partner with Product and Engineering to identify opportunities to expand how customers and

platforms interact with Twist.

Develop and maintain customer-facing documentation (API specifications, integration guides, data-mapping documents, implementation playbooks, etc.) to support consistent and efficient onboarding of customers and platform partners.
Participate in technical discussions, architecture reviews, and solution workshops with customers and platform partners. Travel as needed to support strategic integrations and

complex implementations.

What You’ll Bring

Strong background in API solution architecture, systems integration, or solutions engineering, with experience designing and delivering complex integrations across

multiple organizations and technology platforms.

Deep understanding of REST APIs, web services, JSON/XML, authentication and authorization mechanisms (OAuth 2.0, API keys), webhooks, and asynchronous

integration patterns.

Familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP), AI agent architectures, and emerging standards for enabling AI applications to interact with enterprise APIs and services.
Understanding of how to design secure, governed integrations that expose business capabilities to AI agents, including authentication, authorization, data access, and

transactional workflows.

Ability to translate complex business workflows and technical requirements into practical, scalable integration architectures.
Experience working directly with external customers, technology partners, and third- party engineering teams to define requirements, align on technical approaches, and

drive successful implementations.

Strong understanding of API lifecycle management, including design, documentation, testing, versioning, security, monitoring, and troubleshooting.
Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex integration initiatives simultaneously, working independently and driving technical decisions across cross-functional teams.
Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to both technical and nontechnical audiences.
Strong customer and partner orientation, with a collaborative, proactive, and solutions-

focused mindset.

Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field
8+ years of experience in solution architecture, API integrations, software engineering, or technical delivery roles.
Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering production API integrations involving external customers, technology partners, or enterprise platforms.
Proven ability to serve as a technical lead, influencing architectural decisions and guiding implementation across internal and external engineering teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

Experience designing integrations with B2B marketplaces, eCommerce platforms, or other third-party ecosystems.
Familiarity with life sciences, or scientific product ordering and configuration.

About Twist Bioscience

Twist Bioscience synthesizes genes from scratch, known as “writing” DNA. Just as children learn to both read and write, the next phase of development for the genomics revolution is the ability to write DNA.

At Twist Bioscience, we work in service of people who are changing the world for the better. jobs.description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About The Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.
Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.
Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis.
Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement.
Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams.
Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.
Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.
Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.
A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.
Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives.
Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.
A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.
Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

Annual Salary

$240,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Minimum education:
Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. jobs.title: Systems Development Engineer, AWS Generative AI & ML Servers
jobs.description:
Description

AWS runs the world's largest fleet of AI/ML accelerator servers. When a model with billions of parameters trains across a large scale of GPUs, every minute of downtime costs real progress. We are building the automation, diagnostics, and predictive intelligence that keeps this fleet running at peak. If you want to work at the intersection of hardware, software, and scale — where your code directly prevents customer-impacting failures — this is the role.

We are seeking a Systems Development Engineer to build automation software, diagnostic tooling, and fleet health infrastructure for our accelerated compute platforms. You will work across multiple teams and organizations to design scalable, reliable systems for our accelerated compute fleet.

What You Will Do

You will tackle problems no one has fully defined yet — spanning hardware, firmware, kernel, and software simultaneously. You will own systems end to end, writing code that prevents failures rather than reacts to them, and building automation that replaces manual toil with intelligent self-healing. You will work across PCIe topology, GPU diagnostics, Linux drivers, and telemetry pipelines to correlate signals and isolate faults at fleet scale. When your system catches a failing GPU before a training job crashes, that is your impact.

Why You Will Love It

Your automation runs at a large scale across servers in the cloud. When you ship, you see failure rates move within days. The team is small enough that your decisions shape the architecture, and large enough that you will always have experts to learn from across hardware, firmware, and software.

The Ideal Candidate

You know the full stack from bare-metal to userland. You debug at the intersection of components, not just within them. You build at cloud scale and care how your systems decisions impact customers. You are an excellent communicator who can drive alignment across hardware, software, and operations teams.

Key job responsibilities

Fleet Health & Predictive Infrastructure

Build and own the automation infrastructure for accelerator (AI/ML) fleet health at a large scale of servers, driving toward zero-touch operations that detect, diagnose, triage, and remediate faults without human intervention
Design and develop test frameworks, test coverage strategies, and diagnostic tooling to validate hardware functionality, detect faults, and ensure qualification coverage across the platform lifecycle.
Design predictive failure detection using telemetry, sensor data, error trending, and log correlation to identify degrading components before customer impact
Develop monitoring dashboards and alerting for real-time fleet health visibility across manufacturing, lab, and production environments
Define and track fleet health metrics: failure rates, mean time to detect and resolve issues, first-time fix rate, test dwell time, and predictive accuracy

Debugging & Troubleshooting

Debug complex system-level issues across compute, GPU, and networking in production — including Linux boot/runtime failures, PCIe, power, NIC, NVMe, and GPU subsystems on x86 and ARM
Perform root cause analysis correlating across firmware, kernel, driver, and physical layer; feed findings into manufacturing quality and design improvements

Systems Development & Automation

Design scalable test automation for hardware bring-up, regression, and qualification — reducing manufacturing test cycle times without sacrificing coverage through intelligent test sequencing and parallel execution
Build data pipelines correlating test results, sensor telemetry, and component-level data to identify systemic yield issues and drive upstream fixes
Develop and maintain Linux device drivers on ARM and x86; work with OS internals and accelerator/GPU software stacks
Build and manage tests covering all functional aspects of the system and CI/CD pipelines for rapid deployment to manufacturing lines and production fleet

Cross-Team Collaboration

Work across engineering teams and internal customers to ensure new accelerated compute hardware meets data path, control path, and onboarding requirements
Engage with ODMs and design partners on testability, diagnostic coverage, and automation requirements during hardware design and bring-up phases — influencing functional and performance readiness of the platform
Partner with datacenter operations to close the loop between field failures, manufacturing escapes, and design improvements

Operational Excellence

Participate in post-incident reviews, identify contributing causes and drive permanent fixes that eliminate whole classes of risk
Produce clear, maintainable documentation for systems, runbooks, and automation to enable others to operate and extend your work
Drive process improvements that increase team agility — reducing development friction, eliminating unnecessary gates, and improving delivery velocity

May require occasional (<10%) regional and international travel to Design and Manufacturing Partner sites.

A day in the life

You start the day reviewing overnight validation run results, triaging a cluster of GPU errors that correlate with a specific firmware version. Mid-morning, you push a fix to your diagnostic automation pipeline and validate it catches the failure pattern in your test environment. In the afternoon, you join a hardware bring-up call with your ODM partner to debug a PCIe link training failure on a new EVT board, walking the team through kernel logs and signal integrity data. You end the day reviewing a pull request from a teammate on a new telemetry correlation engine, and updating your manufacturing test coverage dashboard with the latest yield data.

About The Team

The Hardware Engineering AI/ML UltraServer platform team is a group of engineers and technical program managers directly responsible for launching GPU-accelerated servers into the AWS fleet. Located in Seattle, Austin, and Cupertino, we collaborate with global development teams and ODM partners to deliver next-generation AI/ML infrastructure deployed in datacenters worldwide. We move fast with small, empowered teams delivering end-to-end — from server conception through fleet-scale operations.

Basic Qualifications

2+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
1+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
2+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
Knowledge of systems engineering fundamentals (networking, storage, operating systems)
Experience programming with at least one modern language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, Golang, PowerShell, Ruby
2+ years of Linux operating systems experience
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or equivalent work experience

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with PowerShell (preferred), Python, Ruby, or Java
Experience working in an Agile environment using the Scrum methodology
Master's degree in computer science, electrical engineering, or related field
2+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
2+ years of experience with Linux kernel driver development, OS internals, or GPU/accelerator driver integration and diagnostics
Familiarity with troubleshooting and debugging system integration and low level issues across server and GPU hardware, BMC/IPMI, firmware, PCIe topology, and hardware-level fault isolation

Your Impact

You will independently own applied research problems that help organizations understand, evaluate, and improve AI agents across complete workflows. You will develop novel algorithms and research methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and build generalizable AI solutions that balance quality, latency, and cost. jobs.title: Principal Data Scientist - Experimentation & Causal Inference
jobs.description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist - Experimentation & Causal Inference
to serve as the statistical brain behind our rapidly growing experimentation program. You will own the methodology layer that ensures every experiment we run is trustworthy, sensitive, and correctly interpreted.
You will NOT be building infrastructure or writing backend services — our platform engineering team handles that. Your job is to design, validate, and continuously improve the statistical frameworks that sit on top of the platform. You will be the person the team turns to when they ask "Can we trust this result?" — and you will build the automated systems that answer that question before anyone needs to ask.
Team context:
You will join a team of data scientists and platform engineers within the Big Data group, reporting to the Head of Big Data. The experimentation platform engineering team implements your specifications into production systems.

Responsibility

Guardrail Metrics & SRM Detection

Design and maintain automated anomaly detection for live experiments — including Sample Ratio Mismatch (SRM) checks and traffic split validation.
Define alerting thresholds and circuit-breaking criteria so compromised experiments are flagged or stopped before polluting decisions.
Define and validate guardrail metrics (sensitivity, directionality, interpretability) that protect the business during every experiment.

Variance Reduction & Sensitivity

Implement and iterate on CUPED and related pre-experiment covariate adjustment methods to reduce metric variance.
Develop techniques to remove noise from user historical behavior, enabling faster detection of true treatment effects — especially in limited-traffic or high-priority scenarios.
Example of impact we are targeting:
Shorten average experiment duration from 14 days to 9 days, unlocking 40%+ more experiments per quarter.

Continuous A/A Experiment Monitoring

Design and run continuous A/A experiments as an always-on health check for the data pipeline (from client-side event reporting through message queues to the real-time data warehouse).
Monitor metric baseline volatility and pipeline stability, ensuring the instrumentation layer remains trustworthy over time. You define what "healthy" looks like; the platform team implements the monitoring infrastructure.

Other responsibilities

Partner with product, engineering, and growth teams on experiment design: sample size calculations, metric selection, duration estimation, and result interpretation. Advise on causal inference methods (DID, synthetic control, RDD) when randomization is not feasible.
Translate your methods into specifications, validation scripts, and decision frameworks that the team can operationalize — enabling experiment owners to self-serve while maintaining rigor.

Requirements

Education:
MS or PhD in Statistics, Biostatistics, Economics (Econometrics), Computer Science, or a related quantitative field.
Experience:
5+ years of industry experience designing and analyzing online controlled experiments at a tech company with meaningful user scale (not exclusively survey experiments or clinical trials).
Core Statistical Knowledge:
Solid foundations in hypothesis testing, power analysis, multiple testing correction, and sequential testing. Hands-on experience with at least two of: variance reduction methods (CUPED or similar), sample ratio mismatch detection, or continuous data quality monitoring for experiments.
Programming:
Proficient in Python (scipy, statsmodels, or equivalent) for statistical analysis and simulation. Comfortable writing complex SQL (window functions, CTEs) for data extraction and validation.
Communication & Collaboration:
Ability to explain complex statistical concepts to non-technical stakeholders, translate business questions into rigorous experimental designs, and define clear specifications so engineers can implement your methods in production.
AI-Native Workflow:
Strong AI Sense — extensive hands-on experience with AI coding tools (Claude Code, OpenClaw, or similar). Demonstrated ability to leverage AI assistants to automate repetitive analytical tasks, accelerate code development, and build self-serve tooling faster. You treat AI tools as a daily productivity multiplier, not a novelty.

Nice-to-Haves
Familiarity with Bayesian experimentation frameworks or multi-armed bandit approaches.
Understanding of real-time streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Flink) — not as an engineer, but how data flow affects statistical validity.
Publications or conference presentations on experimentation methodology or causal inference (KDD, WSDM, CIKM, NeurIPS CausalML workshop, or equivalent).
Experience in fintech, crypto, or high-frequency trading domains where user behavior has high variance and fast-moving baselines.
