jobs.title: Research Scientist, NeuroAI
jobs.description:
Company Overview

Astera Neuro seeks to understand and engineer consciousness. We believe consciousness is the process by which the brain builds a coherent internal model of the world and the self. We aim to understand this model and to develop the technologies to write experience directly into the brain. By combining large-scale neural recording, causal perturbation, and brain-based AI, we seek to move neuroscience from observing correlates of experience to engineering it. The same tools carry direct therapeutic promise for neurological and psychiatric diseases that alter perception, thought, and sense of self. Because the science and tools required do not yet exist, we are assembling a founding team of neuroscientists, theorists, and engineers to create them. We do high-risk, high-reward science in a well-resourced, collaborative environment with competitive pay, and share everything openly under Astera's Open Science Policy.

Position Summary

Research Scientists in NeuroAI at Astera Neuro develop and lead research programs aimed at understanding how the brain builds a model of the physical world, forms new thoughts, and creates a stable model of the self. The goal is enough understanding and technical ability to precisely and reversibly modulate each of these functions through write-in experiments.

You will bring modern AI and machine learning methods to large-scale neural and behavioral recordings from our primate, rodent, and human programs. Working closely with experimental neuroscientists and engineers, you will build models that uncover how neural circuits in artificial and biological networks represent information and compute, and use those models to guide closed-loop experiments and targeted neural perturbations. This role suits researchers whose primary training is in machine learning; prior neuroscience experience is welcome but not required. Title and scope are calibrated to track record.

What You’ll Do

Develop and lead a machine learning research program to understand how the brain builds an internal model of the world, composes structured thoughts, and guides flexible behavior.
Train foundation models that align neural activity with sensory inputs and behavior across recording sessions, subjects, and species, enabling in silico experiments and closed-loop control of neural activity.
Develop mechanistic interpretability and representation analysis methods to uncover how artificial and biological networks compute, and analyze how neural geometry evolves over time and across task contexts.
Collaborate with experimental neuroscientists to test model predictions in vivo, designing behavioral tasks and closed-loop write-in perturbations that steer neural activity to alter percepts, thoughts, or internal states.
Translate computational principles discovered in the brain into new AI architectures and learning algorithms.
Mentor research engineers and, at the senior or principal level, more junior scientists; contribute to hiring, onboarding, and lab culture.
Contribute to publications, talks, open data and tooling releases, and engagement with the broader scientific community.

Who You Are

Required:

PhD with 3-12+ years of experience in machine learning, computer science, computational neuroscience, physics, applied mathematics, or a related quantitative field, or equivalent research experience.
Demonstrated ability to lead original machine learning research end to end, with depth in areas such as mechanistic interpretability, representation learning, reinforcement learning, world models, or foundation models.
Strong programming and research engineering skills in Python and PyTorch or JAX, with experience building custom architectures, learning objectives, or interpretability tools at scale.
Ability to collaborate closely with neuroscientists and engineers in a fast-moving, interdisciplinary environment.

Preferred/Nice to Have:

Experience in neuroscience, especially collaborating closely with experimentalists, analyzing large-scale neural and behavioral recordings, or conducting experimental work.
Experience connecting the internal computations of artificial networks to biological circuits, or designing model-guided, closed-loop neural perturbation experiments.
Experience scaling training and data pipelines across large, heterogeneous datasets, and contributing to ML or scientific tooling.

What We Value

Deep interest in understanding intelligence in biological and artificial systems.
Conviction that the brain’s internal model can be understood in full, and recognition that getting there requires a kind of science no single academic lab can do.
Willingness to be held to an engineering standard: our decisive tests are write-in experiments, not merely decoding. What we cannot build, we do not understand.
Comfort building on shared infrastructure rather than private projects.
Commitment to open science, including releasing code, models, and data publicly.

Additionally Expected At Senior / Principal Level

Experience setting research direction and leading collaborative projects across disciplines.
Track record of mentorship and technical leadership.

Why Join Us

Join Astera Neuro to work on the hardest and least understood questions in neuroscience: how the brain generates thoughts, intelligence, and consciousness. You will bring machine learning into close contact with large-scale neural experiments, building models that explain biological computation and using discoveries about the brain to inform new approaches to AI.

Astera Neuro provides a comprehensive benefits package and total compensation that is competitive and commensurate with the level of experience and qualifications.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity and inclusion!

Compensation Range: $150K - $350K

jobs.description:
Discover your potential. Build your legacy.

Go the distance with Capital Group

At Capital Group, we go the distance — for our people, our clients, and each other. As a global, privately held firm with more than 95 years of history, we believe meaningful careers, like meaningful investing, are built over the long term. That’s why we invest in our associates with the same conviction we bring to our clients — through career growth, purpose-driven work, whole-person wellness, and rewards that recognize your contributions. Here, you’ll find the opportunity, global scale and support to unlock your potential and build a career that lasts.

The Role

As a Senior Machine Learning Engineer, you will build the next generation of AI products at Capital Group, including agentic systems, LLM-powered workflows, and the platforms that help keep them safe, governed, and reliable in production. Working across production machine learning, generative AI, agentic workflows, and governed data infrastructure, you’ll help define how enterprise-grade AI systems are designed, deployed, and operated. You’ll work with autonomy, mentor junior engineers, and strengthen engineering standards across solutions built on Databricks, AWS, and agent-based architectures. Your work will support responsible innovation and durable AI capabilities for the firm’s long-term needs.

The Team

You’ll be part of the Machine Learning Engineering team, which builds and operates production AI capabilities across Capital Group. The team partners with product, business, data, and engineering groups to turn complex needs into well-scoped, reliable solutions. Its work spans platform engineering, model delivery, agentic systems, and the governance practices required to run AI responsibly at enterprise scale.

Your Impact

Architect and operate end-to-end production AI systems across design, deployment, monitoring, and lifecycle management.
Build cloud-native environments and reusable platform components that support model training, serving, orchestration, and governance.
Design scalable inference pipelines with retraining loops, drift detection, evaluation harnesses, tracing, replay, and observability.
Deliver agentic systems with multi-step reasoning, orchestration, tool and function calling, MCP-based integrations, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop patterns.
Drive the agentic software development lifecycle by defining standards for design, testing, evaluation, deployment, and monitoring.
Build solutions on Databricks and AWS using Unity Catalog, MLflow, Spark, Infrastructure as Code, and cloud-native AI capabilities.
Create REST and streaming APIs, retrieval and memory integrations, and optimized distributed workloads for downstream products and platforms.
Embed data lineage, access controls, audit trails, and responsible AI practices while mentoring engineers and leading code reviews.

What You’ll Bring

7+ years of professional software engineering experience, with strong proficiency in Python and core software engineering fundamentals.
Experience building and operating production machine learning systems end to end, including deployment, monitoring, evaluation, and lifecycle management.
Hands-on experience with AWS and/or Databricks, including native AI and machine learning capabilities and Infrastructure as Code.
Experience integrating generative AI and LLMs using prompt engineering, evaluation techniques, RAG patterns, fine-tuning, and model selection.
Experience developing REST and streaming APIs, plus familiarity with Model Context Protocol.
Strong machine learning fundamentals, including algorithms, evaluation metrics, model tuning, data cleaning, feature engineering, preprocessing, and exploratory analysis.
A bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer science, or a related field.
Ability to operate autonomously on complex initiatives, with experience in CI/CD, DevOps, containerization, deployment pipelines, and testing frameworks.

Preferred

Experience with agentic architectures, including multi-step reasoning, orchestration frameworks, tool and function calling, and agent evaluation.
Experience with AI data infrastructure such as vector stores, graph databases, Redis, DynamoDB, and ElastiCache.
Experience with data governance tools and practices, including Unity Catalog, data lineage, access controls, and audit trails.
Experience with Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale data processing.
Experience designing human-in-the-loop systems, guardrails, LLM output evaluation, and responsible AI practices.

What You’ll Get

When you go the distance for our clients, we go the distance for you. You’ll grow through mentoring, leadership programs and tuition reimbursement, and do work that matters at a firm managing $3T+ in AUM for millions of investors worldwide. We invest in your whole life too – with comprehensive wellness and mental health support, family-first benefits, competitive pay with performance and profitability bonuses and a company-funded retirement plan. And as a privately held firm built for the long term, we offer the opportunity and support to build a career that lasts.

Job Description

The Enterprise Technology Services organization partners with every part of the American Express business to power the company’s growth and innovation with trust and efficiency, and drive competitive differentiation with speed. We support the delivery and operations of technology, digital, and data capabilities, platforms, and services globally. Specifically, our team is responsible for the company’s technology engineering, architecture, and infrastructure, providing 24x7 support to ensure an uninterrupted, high-quality experience for customers and colleagues. We also provide product management for core enterprise platforms, and lead technology risk and information security, enterprise data governance and platforms, digital product and design, and enterprise AI platforms on behalf of the company.

The Sr. AI Engineer II leads the development of advanced AI/machine learning frameworks and innovative natural language processing models, translating complex business needs into scalable models, optimizing Big Data pipelines, ensuring compliance, and foster growth of individuals on the team.

Responsibilities

Supervises and mentors AI Engineers and cross-functional team of colleagues in specific tasks or projects, fostering their professional growth and ensuring adherence to best practices
Ensures seamless integration of AI models into production systems, collaborating closely with cross-functional teams to facilitate smooth integration and ensure alignment and functionality
Monitors and ensures compliance with model governance, security, and compliance standards, continuously monitoring models to ensure adherence to standards and proactively addressing issues
Provides guidance and support to junior AI engineers, fostering professional growth and development within the team
Drives the design and development of sophisticated AI/machine learning frameworks for large-scale data processing, focusing on prompt engineering and generative AI technologies
Directs innovative approaches to apply machine learning algorithms for prompt engineering and natural language processing, solving complex problems and improving model performance
Captures complex business requirements and translates them into sophisticated AI/machine learning-driven solutions, gathering and interpreting intricate business needs to develop advanced models and solutions
Enhances and automates critical business processes by building and optimizing advanced Big Data pipelines and AI-based systems
Leads implementation of new natural language processing models to classify and analyze complex business-related text data, ensuring accurate classification and insightful analysis
Establishes and sustains comprehensive machine leanring operations pipelines that support scalable deployment, monitoring, and maintenance of AI models
Leads design and evolution of complex, distributed AI systems, integrating multiple models, LLMs, and data services into cohesive platforms
Drives development of advanced AI capabilities including multi-stage retrieval pipelines, autonomous workflows, orchestration frameworks, and system-level evaluation
Establishes and enforces standards for AI reliability, safety, explainability, observability, and regulatory compliance across projects
Collaborates and co-creates effectively with teams in product and the business to align technology initiatives with business objectives
Manages complex tasks, requiring an in-depth evaluation of variable factors of moderate to substantial complexity
Impacts multiple projects across multiple teams, influencing technical areas within the function
Makes critical decisions that directly impact project success and operational efficiency

Qualifications

Education and Knowledge

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Data Science, and/or comparable experience; advanced degree preferred
Knowledge of Python and data processing technologies such as Big Data (Hadoop, Spark)
Knowledge of natural language processing techniques like fuzzy wuzzy and models such as BERT, Transformer models, and their real-world applications
Deep expertise in machine learning, including tradeoffs in model selection, evaluation, and optimization
Expert-level understanding of modern AI architectures, including LLM systems, agentic workflows, retrieval strategies, and scalable orchestration patterns

Work Experience

Experience in software development with a focus on machine learning, generative AI, Big Data, and prompt engineering
Experience in working with large language models (LLMs), especially GPT-3.5/4 or similar AI models
Experience in languages such as Python, R, Java, or C++
Experience in deploying AI models and pipelines using machine leanring operations tools
Experience in machine learning algorithms and experience applying them to real-world problems
Experience in continuous integration/continuous deployment pipelines and containerized deployments
Experience in building and maintaining data pipelines and extract, transform, and load processes
Extensive experience architecting and deploying large-scale AI systems in production environments
Experience leading development of distributed AI platforms, real-time inference systems, and cloud-native AI services
Advanced expertise in a technical domain, and moderate expertise across several different domains

Employment eligibility to work with American Express in the United States is required as the company will not pursue visa sponsorship for these positions.

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Competitive base salaries

jobs.title: Senior Applied AI Researcher/Engineer for ISRT Intelligent Systems
jobs.description:
Description

Do you enjoy providing technical leadership, mentoring researchers and engineers, and translating advances in artificial intelligence into robust, mission-relevant capabilities?

Are you interested in shaping innovative approaches in computer vision, deep learning, foundation models, and agentic AI that exploit data from multiple sensors and sources?

Do you want to advance US defense capabilities in Intelligence, Surveillance, Reconnaissance, and Targeting (ISRT)?

If so, we're looking for someone like you to join our team at APL!

We are seeking a creative and expert Senior Applied AI Researcher/Engineer to lead efforts to conceptualize, develop, test, assess, and field the next generation of ISRT and Counter-ISRT capabilities for the US military. Our team combines an understanding of the physical processes being sensed with advanced methods of signal and image processing, sensor and data fusion, operations research, and artificial intelligence to build systems that make intelligent inferences and predictions about complex threats and environments. Our work enables the US military to neutralize a wider variety of serious threats from safer distances than they could otherwise accomplish; improves the safety, survivability, and effectiveness of US air, naval, and ground forces; and disrupts the ability of potential adversaries to threaten our forces.

As a Senior Applied AI Researcher/Engineer for ISRT Intelligent Systems…

Your primary responsibility will be to lead and contribute to multidisciplinary teams researching, developing, and transitioning AI/ML algorithms and prototype software for complex ISRT applications.
You will establish technical approaches and guide model design, adaptation, training, evaluation, and integration across areas such as computer vision, neural networks, transformers, large language models, and multimodal learning.
You will architect AI-enabled systems that exploit imagery and other sensor data, integrate information across sources, and, where appropriate, use retrieval-augmented generation, intelligent agents, and tool-based workflows.
You will define rigorous experimentation and evaluation strategies, establish meaningful performance metrics, and assess model robustness, generalization, uncertainty, explainability, and operational limitations.
You will lead the maturation of research prototypes into well-engineered capabilities, balancing technical performance, computational constraints, integration risks, and mission requirements.
You will help develop new research directions and proposals, translate sponsor needs into executable technical plans, and guide technical priorities, schedules, and deliverables.
You will mentor junior researchers and engineers, review technical work, and foster sound research, software engineering, and responsible AI practices.
You will lead technical communications with project leadership and government sponsors and present team results through briefings, reports, publications, and technical forums.

Qualifications

You meet our minimum qualifications for the job if you...

Have a Master’s degree in computer science, computer engineering, electrical engineering, applied mathematics, physics, data science, or another related technical field.
Have at least seven years of relevant professional experience in AI/ML research, algorithm development, applied data science, or intelligent software systems.
Have demonstrated technical depth in one or more modern AI/ML areas such as computer vision, deep neural networks, transformers, large language models, multimodal learning, or agentic AI, with the ability to evaluate and select appropriate approaches.
Have significant hands-on experience using Python and modern machine learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or Hugging Face Transformers to develop, train, adapt, and evaluate models.
Have a record of leading complex technical efforts, guiding multidisciplinary teams, and delivering research or prototype capabilities with measurable results.
Have participated as a principal investigator, key contributor, or key advisor on an internal or external research proposal that was funded.
Have experience designing technically rigorous experiments, interpreting results, and communicating tradeoffs and limitations to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
Have strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills and the ability to mentor staff, support concurrent projects, and adapt to evolving priorities.
Are willing and able to work a portion of the time in secure, closed areas and travel occasionally to government sites and contractor facilities (local and non-local).
Are able to obtain an Interim Secret level security clearance by your start date and can ultimately a TS/SCI level clearance. If selected, you will be subject to a government security clearance investigation and must meet the requirements for access to classified information. Eligibility requirements include U.S. citizenship.

You'll go above and beyond our minimum requirements if you...

Have a Doctorate degree in a related technical field.
Have demonstrated experience leading applied research involving vision-language models, multimodal sensor fusion, LLM adaptation/evaluation, or agentic AI and multi-agent systems.
Have experience with ISR sensor data, remote sensing, computer vision for imagery exploitation, tracking, sensor/data fusion, or autonomous decision-support systems.
Have experience transitioning AI/ML research into operational or production-relevant systems, including scalable inference, deployment constraints, model monitoring, and repeatable evaluation.
Have experience developing funded research concepts, shaping sponsor-facing technical roadmaps, or serving as a principal investigator or technical lead.
Have familiarity with trustworthy and responsible AI, including reliability, uncertainty, explainability, human-machine teaming, and evaluation under distribution shift.
Hold an active Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI-level security clearance.

About Us

Why Work at APL?

The Johns Hopkins University Applied Physics Laboratory (APL) brings world-class expertise to our nation’s most critical defense, security, space and science challenges. While we are dedicated to solving complex challenges and pioneering new technologies, what makes us truly outstanding is our culture. We offer a vibrant, welcoming atmosphere where you can bring your authentic self to work, continue to grow, and build strong connections with inspiring teammates.

At APL, we celebrate our differences of perspectives and encourage creativity and bold, new ideas. Our employees enjoy generous benefits, including a robust education assistance program, unparalleled retirement contributions, and a healthy work/life balance. APL’s campus is located in the Baltimore-Washington metro area. Learn more about our career opportunities at https://www.jhuapl.edu/careers.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, creed, color, religion, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, occupation, marital or familial status, political opinion, personal appearance, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. APL is committed to providing reasonable accommodation to individuals of all abilities, including those with disabilities. If you require a reasonable accommodation to participate in any part of the hiring process, please contact Accessibility@jhuapl.edu.

The referenced pay range is based on JHU APL’s good faith belief at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location, work experience, market conditions, education/training and skill level with consideration for internal parity. For salaried employees scheduled to work less than 40 hours per week, annual salary will be prorated based on the number of hours worked. APL may offer bonuses or other forms of compensation per internal policy and/or contractual designation. Additional compensation may be provided in the form of a sign-on bonus, relocation benefits, locality allowance or discretionary payments for exceptional performance. APL provides eligible staff with a comprehensive benefits package including retirement plans, paid time off, medical, dental, vision, life insurance, short-term disability, long-term disability, flexible spending accounts, education assistance, and training and development. Applications are accepted on a rolling basis.

jobs.title: Principal Machine Learning Engineer, Recommendation Algorithm
jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Principal Recommendation Algorithm Engineer, you will be responsible for personalized recommendations across the trading products, content, and community. You will understand how user behavior evolves across scenarios; model cross-scenario behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent; and jointly optimize objectives such as clicks, conversions, and retention to improve recommendation performance and user experience.
You will work closely with recommendation engineering, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available personalization system serving more than 80 million users globally. You will drive technical advances in personalized recommendations, distribution strategies, user understanding, and content understanding.

Key Responsibilities

Develop and improve recommendation models for the trading products, content, and community. Use large-scale user behavior data to model user interests accurately and improve recommendation performance and user experience.
Explore cross-domain transfer and cold-start optimization across business scenarios, taking each scenario's characteristics into account to improve cross-scenario recommendation results and cold-start coverage.
Optimize multi-objective ranking models for CTR, CVR, LTV, and other outcomes. Design mechanisms for combining ranking objectives and balance clicks, conversions, and long-term value under scenario-specific constraints.
Model cross-scenario user behavior sequences, short- and long-term interests, and changes in intent. Develop reusable user representations to address scenario transfer, sparse feedback, and cold-start challenges.
Explore generative recommendation approaches, including semantic IDs and generative candidate generation, and integrate generative methods with discriminative recommendation pipelines.

Major Requirements

At least 4 years of experience developing search, advertising, or recommendation algorithms at a consumer-facing internet company, with a deep understanding of retrieval, ranking, and multi-objective modeling.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Python, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging problems.
Strong analytical and logical thinking, with the ability to identify problems and opportunities in data.
An interest in emerging technologies and the ability to approach challenging problems with clarity and sound reasoning.
Good business judgment and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate on and solve business problems.

Nice-to-have:

Search, advertising, or recommendation algorithm experience at major technology companies
Experience with multi-objective modeling, short- and long-term user sequence modeling, personalized uplift modeling, or generative modeling.
Publications at leading international conferences, including but not limited to KDD, SIGIR, RecSys, ACL, or NeurIPS.
An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.

Why Join Us

A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:
Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows.
Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:
Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade.
Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:
Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering.
An opportunity to lead, not just follow:
Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration.
Global scale:
Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

Who We Are

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI‑powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high‑stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we’re deeply committed to expanding access to technology for academic institutions through Relativity Academic and supporting pro bono legal work through Justice for Change

What We Do

About AI And Data Science At Relativity

Over the past two years, billions of documents have benefited from Relativity AI, and we are just beginning. We use AI to improve every user experience, product, matter, and investigation—helping users find the truth faster and act on data with confidence. At the same time, Relativity’s scale creates rich opportunities for data exploration, and our market reach helps turn insights into impact quickly. Our infrastructure makes data available for analysis while keeping it secure and protected, and we continue to invest in modern data-pipeline and data-lake technology.

We prioritize algorithm excellence to deliver a robust, trusted experience.

We are building a world-class toolset to solve complex challenges quickly.

We apply AI across discovery to improve case management and product operations.

Our team values curiosity, experimentation, and continuous learning. We test boldly, learn quickly, and improve every day. If you’re looking for a data-rich, AI-driven environment with large-scale challenges and room to innovate, you’ll feel at home on Relativity’s AI team. Join us to help shape the culture, practices, and technical vision for machine learning at Relativity.

What You’ll Do

As a Senior AI Engineer at Relativity, you will design and build the AI/ML platforms and processes that support applied science and product engineering teams. PTC’s software is used to design, build and service many of the world’s most complex products, from aircraft and cars to medical devices and industrial equipment. We’re bringing AI into that portfolio, and we’re looking for engineers who want to build AI that holds up in demanding, real-world environments.

As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you will build these systems and take them from prototype to production. You will work in a small, fast-moving squad, with engineers, product managers and designers, shipping agentic features that real customers use.

Key Responsibilities

Build AI agents and the services around them, using LLMs, retrieval and agentic workflows, and connect them to PTC's products, data and APIs.
Make agents production grade: state that survives restarts, long running work that pauses for human input and resumes, tool permissions scoped to each user, and defenses against prompt injection.
Develop the APIs, tools and integrations, including MCP servers, that let agents act on enterprise systems safely.
Build eval suites and automated tests that catch regressions as models, prompts and data change, and use them as release gates.
Instrument services with metrics, monitoring and tracing for quality, latency and cost, and use that data to improve the system in production.
Ship continuously and own what you ship, from design through deployment, including participating in an on-call rotation for the services your team runs.
Raise the bar for the team through code review, design discussions and mentoring, working with security, architecture and engineering colleagues across PTC's global organization.

Qualifications

5+ years of software engineering, including building and running distributed services or SaaS applications.
Experience shipping at least one LLM-based feature (an agent, a RAG system or an AI workflow) to production users, not just prototypes.
Strong skills in at least one of Python, Java, TypeScript or C++.
Solid fundamentals: software design, APIs, data structures, automated testing and modern development practices.
Experience with cloud-native development on Azure, AWS or GCP: containers, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
Experience integrating AI models with application logic, enterprise data and external tools.
Sound judgment on technical trade-offs, and ownership of features from design through production support.
Clear communication and experience working with distributed teams
A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field, or equivalent experience.

Experience with agent frameworks such as LangGraph or LangChain, and with MCP.
Experience with vector search, embeddings and retrieval pipelines over enterprise knowledge.
Experience with AI evaluation frameworks, LLMOps and observability tools (for example Datadog).
Experience in enterprise software, CAD, PLM (product lifecycle management), ALM (application lifecycle management), SLM (service lifecycle management), industrial software or a related domain.

jobs.title: Data Scientist - Career
jobs.description:
Our Data Scientist
roles are unique. The ideal candidate is a rare hybrid, a scientist with the programming abilities to scrape, combine, and manage data from a variety of sources and a statistician who knows how to derive insights from the information within. He or she will combine the skills to create new prototypes with the creativity and thoroughness to ask and answer the deepest questions about the data, what secrets it holds, and to push the boundaries of what is possible with big data. Want to know more?

Job Description

As a Data Scientist (P3) on the Fraud Modeling Team, you will lead the design, development, and deployment of high-impact machine learning and advanced statistical models to combat First-Party Fraud, Third-Party Fraud, Synthetic Identity Fraud, and support Identity Graph Analytics.

Operating independently within a collaborative matrixed environment, you will bridge technical model execution with commercial outcomes. You will collaborate closely with cross-functional partners—including Product, Sales, Core Analytics, and Model Risk Management (MRM)—to build stress-tested, deployable fraud detection engines, ensure regulatory alignment, and communicate technical business impact to leadership.

What You'll Do

Fraud Model Development & Optimization: Independently design, train, and optimize predictive models using XGBoost, Gradient Boosted Trees, Transformer-based models, and deep learning architectures tailored for high-dimensional, imbalanced fraud datasets.
Identity Graph & Identity Analytics: Leverage graph structures and identity link analysis to detect synthetic identity networks, fraud rings, and suspicious identity resolution patterns across large datasets.
Domain Focus Areas: Develop actionable fraud detection frameworks targeting First-Party Fraud, Third-Party Fraud, and Synthetic Identity Fraud.
Stakeholder Management & Governance:
Partner with product and sales to translate market requirements into technical model specifications and vice versa.
Collaborate with Model Risk Management (MRM) to pass model validation, conceptual soundness checks, and compliance reviews.

Data Engineering & Querying: Query, manipulate, and structure massive historical dataset assets using advanced SQL and Python to engineer complex behavioural features and fraud signals.
Production & Code Quality: Write clean, modular, and efficient code following version control best practices (Git). Contribute to core internal code repositories and perform code reviews for peer accuracy.
Technical Mentorship & Storytelling: Package complex statistical outputs into visual narratives and executive presentations for mid-level leadership and non-technical stakeholders. Mentor junior data scientists on modeling standards.

What Experience You Need

Education & Experience

Education: Master’s degree (or equivalent practical experience) in a highly quantitative STEM field: Statistics, Computer Science, Physics, Mathematics, Engineering, Data Science, or related discipline.
Identity & Graph Experience: Hands-on experience with graph neural networks (GNNs) or graph databases (e.g., Neo4j, NetworkX) for entity resolution and graph-based feature engineering.
Experience: 5 to 7 years of hands-on data science experience, with direct focus on developing predictive models for fraud risk, identity resolution, or risk management.

Technical Skills

Machine Learning & Modeling: Deep expertise in tree-based ensembles (XGBoost, LightGBM) and modern deep learning models (Transformers, Neural Networks, Sequence Models).
Programming & Database: Advanced Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-Learn, PyTorch/TensorFlow) and expert-level SQL query development for complex data extraction and feature engineering.
Software Development & MLOps: Proficiency with version control software, CI/CD practices, modular code design, and statistical repositories.
Model Evaluation: Strong grounding in stress-testing models, cross-validation on highly imbalanced target distributions, model explainability, and performance tuning.

What Could Set You Apart

Cloud Infrastructure: Experience working in cloud environment deployment workflows (AWS, GCP, Azure Data Lake / SageMaker) with Cloud Certification preferred.
Regulatory Knowledge: Familiarity with MRM documentation standards (e.g., SR 11-7 guidelines) and model governance protocols.

Additional Job Description

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicates complex ML concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders while aligning technically with MRM.
Accountability & Integrity: Operates as a trusted data steward, maintaining strict compliance and personal ownership over model performance and data integrity.
Intellectual Curiosity & Innovation: Continuously seeks innovative ML architectures to elevate fraud detection efficacy.
Drive Results with Urgency: Delivers moderately complex, production-ready modeling pipelines on time with speed, accuracy, and minimum operational supervision.

jobs.title: Senior Data Science
jobs.description:
Job Description

Position Summary

We aspire to be the premier research-intensive biopharmaceutical company. We're at the forefront of research to deliver innovative health solutions that advance the prevention and treatment of diseases in people and animals. The Cyber Applied AI team is looking for a Senior Data Scientist to build detection and investigation analytics over enterprise security data. The work is statistical: finding unusual behavior in very high-volume network and endpoint telemetry, measuring similarity between security events, correlating alerts from multiple sources into unified incidents mapped to MITRE ATT&CK, and turning threat intelligence into structured, usable data. The person in this role takes an analytical method from idea through validation and into production, and owns the data pipelines that feed it.

This is a senior individual contributor role for a data scientist who also engineers. The person in it designs the method, builds the pipelines and services that run it, deploys it on Azure or AWS, and keeps it in production. That includes applied AI work: building AI-driven analysis systems that use Model Context Protocol (MCP) tools over security data stores to automate investigation and shorten triage, and exposing results through APIs and automated reporting.

Responsibilities

Build and maintain statistical anomaly detection over network telemetry at the scale of billions of records per day, using behavioral baselines, percentile thresholds (p95/p99), new and rare entity detection, and feature engineering.
Design correlation frameworks that use IDF weighting, entity similarity metrics, and MITRE ATT&CK mappings to aggregate EDR and other security telemetry into unified security events.
Implement these methods as production workflows in Azure Data Explorer using KQL functions and materialized views.
Evaluate detection and correlation methods with defined metrics (precision, recall, false positive rate, time to triage), validate them against labeled incidents and analyst feedback, and monitor for drift once in production.
Build pipelines that extract CVEs, indicators of compromise, and other structured intelligence from unstructured sources such as security news and vendor reporting.
Design AI-driven security analysis systems that use MCP tools against Azure Data Explorer and threat intelligence services to automate investigations and reduce triage time.
Turn analytical methods into repeatable detection and investigation workflows with automated reporting.
Design and operate the data pipelines that feed the analytics, including batch and streaming ingestion on AWS (S3, Lambda, Glue, Step Functions, Kinesis) and Azure.
Write ETL/ELT transformations in Spark and Python for large cybersecurity datasets.
Identify where a purpose-built analytical system can replace a commercial product and build it when the economics justify it.

This position has the option of working a hybrid (preferred) or remote schedule.

Description

UC San Diego Health is on a journey to build and mature enterprise applied artificial intelligence capabilities that deliver meaningful, measurable impact at scale across the health system. This work reflects a sustained organizational commitment to developing these capabilities as a core part of how care is delivered and supported. The purpose of UCSDH’s applied AI efforts is grounded in the quadruple aim, using AI-enabled technologies to simultaneously expand access to care, improve clinical and operational outcomes, enhance quality and safety, and support a better experience for both patients and care teams. A key focus is leveraging real-time data, predictive, generative, and hybrid models, and increasingly automated interventions to demonstrably achieve impact at scale across the health system.

Central to this strategy is the Mission Control vision, which brings together real-time data and applied AI–driven decision support to provide system-wide insight and action across the care continuum, including population health. This initiative serves both as a delivery layer for targeted point solutions across the health system and as a centralized hub for system-level assessment, prediction, and coordinated action. The supporting technology landscape is intentionally dynamic, with an emphasis on identifying best-fit solutions over time while scaling a cohesive enterprise platform that integrates complementary tools and capabilities.

This position operates within the Jacobs Center for Health Innovation and is integrated into UC San Diego Health Information Services, sharing leadership, data, and infrastructure, while driving translational innovation and supporting enterprise operations at scale.

Position And Team

UC San Diego Health is seeking a Senior Data Scientist to work within the Joan & Irwin Jacobs Center for Health Innovation (JCHI) on all phases of AI model design and development. The role is responsible for the full model lifecycle, including intake and review, data preparation, model development, evaluation, pre-deployment preparation, deployment, and post-deployment model monitoring and management. This includes applying advanced statistical and machine learning methods, causal inference, and experimental design to ensure models not only predict outcomes but drive measurable impact through real-world interventions.

The position operates within a multidisciplinary environment that includes cloud engineers, product managers, AI/automation engineers, application developers, architects, and enterprise platform teams. The Senior Data Scientist owns technical execution across the model lifecycle while partnering closely with product managers who drive product strategy, prioritization, and stakeholder alignment. The position reports to the JCHI Co-Director, who provides functional leadership for data science and AI initiatives and works across JCHI and Information Services stakeholders to align priorities, capabilities, and delivery.

This is a senior technical role that requires the ability to independently lead complex data science projects, mentor junior team members, and contribute to the strategic direction of the data science program. The role involves close collaboration with clinical and operational stakeholders to identify high-impact use cases, translate clinical questions into data science problems, and deliver AI solutions that create sustained value across the health system. This includes working across diverse data modalities (e.g., structured EHR data, time-series, imaging, and unstructured text) and leveraging state-of-the-art approaches, including predictive, generative, and hybrid models.

What We’re Looking For

The ideal candidate brings deep experience across the full AI model lifecycle in healthcare or complex enterprise environments, with demonstrated ability to independently lead projects from data exploration through production deployment and ongoing monitoring. Experience with healthcare EHR data, particularly Epic, is essential, and candidates should be comfortable working with complex, multimodal clinical datasets to develop models that drive measurable improvements in patient care and health system operations at scale.

Experience developing AI models using traditional machine learning, large language models, and hybrid approaches is strongly desired, including familiarity with cloud-based data science platforms such as AWS and modern ML infrastructure. Candidates should be highly proficient in Python, R, SQL, and related tools, with strong expertise in model evaluation, benchmarking, and performance optimization, as well as applying rigorous methods to ensure robustness, generalizability, and real-world impact.

Successful candidates will also demonstrate strong familiarity with enterprise health system operations and technologies, including electronic health records, healthcare data integration, and cloud platforms, along with the regulatory and privacy considerations unique to healthcare AI. The role requires the ability to work effectively across clinical, operational, technical, and vendor stakeholders, and to contribute to data science strategy in environments where innovation, scientific rigor, and patient safety must coexist.

Minimum Qualifications

Nine (9) years of related experience, education/training, OR a Bachelor’s degree in related area plus five (5) years of related experience/training. Related experience includes data science, computational science, machine learning, AI model development, and work with healthcare EHR data (e.g., Epic).
Advanced knowledge of HPC / data science / CI.
Highly advanced skills, and demonstrated experience associated with one or more of the following: HPC hardware and software power and performance analysis and research, design, modification, implementation and deployment of HPC or data science or CI applications and tools of large-scale scope.
Demonstrated ability to regularly, effectively communicate with unit-level management.

Self-motivated and works independently and as part of a team.
Advanced experience working in a complex computing / data / CI environment encompassing all or some of the following: HPC, data science infrastructure and tools / software, and diverse domain science application base.
In depth ability to successfully work and / or lead multiple concurrent projects. Demonstrated research and technology project leadership and management skills.
In depth experience assessing a broad spectrum of technical and research needs and demands and establish priorities, delegate and / or lead development of solutions to meet such needs.
Demonstrated advanced experience in one or more of the following: optimizing, benchmarking, HPC performance and power modeling, analyzing hardware, software, and applications for HPC / data / CI.

Preferred Qualifications

Strong data science discipline across the full AI model lifecycle (intake, data prep, model development, evaluation, deployment, monitoring). Demonstrated ability to lead complex data science research projects with multi-institutional scope and serve as technical lead.

Benefits

Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, and Disability Insurance
401(k) with company match
Pre-tax spending accounts including health care FSA and commuter savings

Professional development reimbursement and ongoing skills training opportunities
Employee resource groups
Swag, ticket giveaways, and more!

At BetMGM, we recognize that every individual plays a meaningful role in our success. That’s why we’re committed to building a respectful, inclusive workplace. It’s the strategy behind every win. By meeting people where they are, we create a culture of belonging where everyone can thrive and a workplace that reflects our values, our people, and our drive to win.

The Opportunity

About The Role

The Sr. MLOps Engineer treats ML systems as software systems and owns the path from a trained model to a production endpoint that meets its latency, cost, and reliability budgets — across both batch scoring (SageMaker Batch Transform, Snowflake Cortex / Snowpark ML, dbt-orchestrated scoring) and real-time inference (SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock, sub-second feature serving). The Sr. Engineer builds the platform that data scientists and ML engineers ship on: feature store with guaranteed online/offline parity, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift and quality monitoring, champion/challenger and shadow deployment scaffolding. This requires a software-engineering-first mindset — distributed systems, observability, and on-call instincts are the foundation; ML literacy makes them effective for this role. GenAI integration experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Responsibilities

ML Production Platform
Stand up and operate BetMGM's ML platform on AWS (SageMaker Training, Model Registry, Pipelines, Endpoints, Batch Transform) and Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), with Terraform-managed infrastructure
Build self-service scaffolds that let data scientists ship a model end-to-end without a ticket queue — cookie-cutter project templates with CI, drift monitoring, alerting, IaC, and Snowflake connectivity pre-baked

Batch and Real-Time Inference
Design and operate batch scoring pipelines — SageMaker Batch Transform, dbt-orchestrated scoring against Snowflake, Snowpark ML — with explicit freshness and cost SLAs.
Design and operate real-time inference paths — SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock for GenAI, API Gateway — with stated latency budgets (typically sub-100ms) and graceful degradation under load.
Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity — training-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff.

CI/CD and Deployment Patterns
Build CI/CD for ML — model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature → training run → deployed model → live prediction.
Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project.

Monitoring, Drift & Reliability
Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor — pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it.
Own MLOps incident response — production model failures are SEV events with postmortems.

Cost and Performance
Right-size endpoints, batch caching, request batching, and autoscaling. State cost-per-prediction targets up front and meet them.

GenAI Integration (Plus, Not Required)
Integrate LLM APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into production paths — RAG pipelines, agent eval frameworks, prompt versioning, cost and latency observability.
Partner with the Helix team on AI personalization workloads as they ramp toward March Madness 2027.
undefined
AI in the Engineering Loop
Direct AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, dbt Copilot) as a force multiplier across infrastructure code, eval suites, and model-serving glue — designing work for agents to do, not just accepting their suggestions.

Collaboration
Partner with the data engineering team on shared standards (Terraform modules, CI/CD patterns, observability, lineage).
Work alongside data scientists and analytics partners to land the right interfaces between research and production — opinionated about the boundary.
Coordinate with Entain India and contractor ML partners as workloads consolidate onto the BetMGM-owned platform.

Qualifications
BS or MS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Machine Learning, or other STEM field — or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience wins ties; a PhD is neither required nor a tiebreakers
Must-Haves
5+ years shipping software in production — Python, Docker, Kubernetes or ECS, CI/CD, distributed systems debugging — including time on-call.
3+ years operating ML in production — you have owned a model in prod that served real traffic, with stated latency and cost budgets and a runbook you wrote.
AWS depth across the SageMaker surface (Training, Endpoints, Batch Transform, Model Registry, Pipelines) plus the supporting cast (IAM, Lambda, ECS, S3, Secrets Manager, VPC).
Snowflake fluency — Snowpark ML, Cortex, dbt-orchestrated batch scoring, RBAC for ML workloads.
IaC for ML — Terraform + SageMaker Pipelines or equivalent. No manual console deployments to production.
Feature store experience — SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast — with explicit ownership of online/offline parity.
Champion/challenger, shadow, and canary deployment patterns as production muscle, not blog-post familiarity.
Drift and model monitoring — Evidently, Arize, WhyLabs, or SageMaker Model Monitor — wired to a paging path.
Software-engineering-first mindset — you treat ML systems as systems, not notebooks.
Nice-to-Haves
GenAI in production — Bedrock, Anthropic, or OpenAI APIs integrated into live systems; RAG pipelines; vector DBs (Snowflake Cortex Search, pgvector, Pinecone); evaluation frameworks (Langfuse or in-house).
Snowflake-native ML — Snowpark Container Services, Cortex AISQL, Cortex Agents — for workloads that do not need to leave the warehouse.
Streaming feature engineering — Kafka, Flink, or Snowpipe Streaming — for sub-second features.
Fine-tuning experience — LoRA, QLoRA, instruction tuning, eval-driven iteration — with an honest read on when fine-tuning beats prompting.
A track record of shipping more with AI in the engineering loop than without.
Regulated-industry experience (gaming, fintech, healthcare) — comfort with model risk, audit, and lineage requirements.

The Sr. Engineer builds the platform that data scientists and ML engineers ship on: feature store with guaranteed online/offline parity, model registry, CI/CD for ML, drift and quality monitoring, champion/challenger and shadow deployment scaffolding. This requires a software-engineering-first mindset — distributed systems, observability, and on-call instincts are the foundation; ML literacy makes them effective for this role. GenAI integration experience is a plus, not a requirement.

Responsibilities

ML Production Platform
Stand up and operate BetMGM's ML platform on AWS (SageMaker Training, Model Registry, Pipelines, Endpoints, Batch Transform) and Snowflake (Snowpark ML, Cortex), with Terraform-managed infrastructure
Build self-service scaffolds that let data scientists ship a model end-to-end without a ticket queue — cookie-cutter project templates with CI, drift monitoring, alerting, IaC, and Snowflake connectivity pre-baked

Batch and Real-Time Inference
Design and operate batch scoring pipelines — SageMaker Batch Transform, dbt-orchestrated scoring against Snowflake, Snowpark ML — with explicit freshness and cost SLAs.
Design and operate real-time inference paths — SageMaker real-time endpoints, Lambda + Bedrock for GenAI, API Gateway — with stated latency budgets (typically sub-100ms) and graceful degradation under load.
Own the feature store (SageMaker Feature Store, Tecton, or Feast) with guaranteed online/offline parity — training-serving skew is treated as an incident, not a tradeoff.

CI/CD and Deployment Patterns
Build CI/CD for ML — model registry, automated retraining triggers, model versioning, lineage from feature → training run → deployed model → live prediction.
Implement champion/challenger, shadow deployments, and canary releases as platform primitives so individual model teams do not reinvent them per project.

Monitoring, Drift & Reliability
Stand up drift detection, data quality, and model performance monitoring (Evidently, Arize, or SageMaker Model Monitor — pick one and standardize) with paging that routes to humans who can fix it.
Own MLOps incident response — production model failures are SEV events with postmortems.

Cost and Performance
Right-size endpoints, batch caching, request batching, and autoscaling. State cost-per-prediction targets up front and meet them.

GenAI Integration (Plus, Not Required)
Integrate LLM APIs (Bedrock, Anthropic, OpenAI) into production paths — RAG pipelines, agent eval frameworks, prompt versioning, cost and latency observability.
Partner with the Helix team on AI personalization workloads as they ramp toward March Madness 2027.
undefined
AI in the Engineering Loop
Direct AI coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, dbt Copilot) as a force multiplier across infrastructure code, eval suites, and model-serving glue — designing work for agents to do, not just accepting their suggestions.

Collaboration
Partner with the data engineering team on shared standards (Terraform modules, CI/CD patterns, observability, lineage).
Work alongside data scientists and analytics partners to land the right interfaces between research and production — opinionated about the boundary.
Coordinate with Entain India and contractor ML partners as workloads consolidate onto the BetMGM-owned platform.

Qualifications
BS or MS in Computer Science, Math, Statistics, Machine Learning, or other STEM field — or equivalent practical experience. Practical experience wins ties; a PhD is neither required nor a tiebreakers
Must-Haves
5+ years shipping software in production — Python, Docker, Kubernetes or ECS, CI/CD, distributed systems debugging — including time on-call.
3+ years operating ML in production — you have owned a model in prod that served real traffic, with stated latency and cost budgets and a runbook you wrote.
AWS depth across the SageMaker surface (Training, Endpoints, Batch Transform, Model Registry, Pipelines) plus the supporting cast (IAM, Lambda, ECS, S3, Secrets Manager, VPC).
Snowflake fluency — Snowpark ML, Cortex, dbt-orchestrated batch scoring, RBAC for ML workloads.
IaC for ML — Terraform + SageMaker Pipelines or equivalent. No manual console deployments to production.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, AI-Native
jobs.description:
About Carpe & the Role

Carpe is an AI-native company building platforms and data products that help P&C insurance carriers make better decisions. At Carpe, we don’t hand-write code anymore. We build with AI. As a Senior AI Software Engineer, you will turn business needs and prototypes into reliable production systems by directing frontier models and coding agents, shaping the environments they work in, and verifying what they deliver. AI is your primary way of building—not an autocomplete tool added to a traditional coding workflow. You bring extensive hands-on experience with frontier models, agents, and agent harnesses, plus the engineering judgment to take their work all the way through AWS deployment and production operation.

You’ll have a say in how we build. Our design and architecture patterns give you a solid starting point, not a set of limits. If a new approach or technology will better serve our customers, make the case. We care far more about how you think through tradeoffs than whether you’ve used every tool we use.

Responsibilities

Turn business needs into executable work.
Partner with Product to define the problem, constraints, acceptance criteria, and customer outcome. Give agents the specifications, repository context, examples, and verification steps they need to deliver the right solution; resolve ambiguity before it becomes working software that solves the wrong problem.
Architect systems and direct AI delivery.
Break complex work into bounded tasks, choose interfaces and data flows, and direct agents through implementation, integration, and debugging. Use our approved patterns to address scale, latency, reliability, and data correctness across products. You own the architecture and outcome, even when AI produces the code.
Build effective agent workflows and harnesses.
Scope and steer bots through our team workflow, including Slack and Linear. Configure the context, tools, permissions, execution environments, and feedback loops around agents; manage handoffs, checkpoints, and recovery when they stall or go off course. Run a tight build-and-verify loop: the agent builds, you exercise the result in a live test environment, feed back precise findings, and repeat until the acceptance criteria are met.
Choose models and approaches deliberately.
Evaluate frontier models and coding agents on real engineering tasks, comparing output quality, reliability, context handling, latency, and cost. Match the model and harness to the work, and adapt as capabilities change. Let customer outcomes, not tool loyalty, guide decisions.
Prove the result, not the agent’s claim.
Review architecture and generated changes at the level the risk demands; personally inspect sensitive changes. Use independent checks, representative data, automated tests, regression checks, and end-to-end behavior to catch plausible-but-wrong output. Where systems use models at runtime, evaluate their behavior and failure modes too.
Ship and operate in AWS.
Take AI-built software through cloud deployment and production support with QA and DevOps. Direct and verify infrastructure-as-code and CI/CD changes; understand access controls, secrets, networking, data storage, rollout, and rollback. Use logs, metrics, and traces to diagnose failures, verify recovery, and own incident follow-through—including failures introduced by agents.
Make the next AI build better.
Turn successful approaches and failures into reusable agent instructions, repository guidance, harness improvements, and verification routines. Keep architecture and operational context current so both people and agents can build on it.

What we are looking for

7+ years of professional software engineering, delivering and supporting production systems (overall experience, not five years with today’s AI tools).
Extensive frontier-model experience.
Substantial use of frontier models across multiple model families—for example, OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini—in real software delivery. You can explain which models you choose for planning, implementation, debugging, and review; where they fail; and how you evaluate a new release. You actively experiment and clearly prefer building with AI over a hand-coding-first workflow.
Extensive agent and harness experience
. You have shipped meaningful work with coding agents and agent harnesses—not just chat prompts or autocomplete. Examples may include Claude Code, Codex, other agentic development environments, or custom harnesses. Extra credit for OpenClaw. You can configure repository instructions, context and tool access, isolated execution, task decomposition, verification, and recovery, and explain when orchestration helps versus adding overhead.
End-to-end systems ownership.
You have personally designed a complete system through professional or substantial independent work, with relevant professional experience around similar systems. Show how you directed AI from an initial specification through a working, deployed result, what you personally decided, and how you established that it worked. You don’t need to have led a large-system initiative.
Engineering depth behind the agents.
Strong programming, debugging, architecture, and systems reasoning. You can read and interrogate generated code, trace data flows and service interactions, identify flawed assumptions, and steer a correction. We value your ability to make AI-built systems correct and maintainable—not the volume of code you type.
AWS and cloud deployment experience.
You have deployed and supported production software in AWS and understand the path from repository to running service: infrastructure as code, CI/CD, compute or containers, storage, networking, IAM, secrets, observability, and rollback. Explain a deployment or incident you owned and how you verified the outcome.
Roll-up-your-sleeves, low-ego collaboration
. Comfortable steering agents, investigating failures, explaining tradeoffs, and influencing without direct authority in a small. Share work and blockers openly, move across products, and help teammates improve their AI workflows while staying accountable for the customer outcome.

Why Carpe?

Your work shows up fast. At our size, what you build reaches customers quickly, and you quickly make an impact
Growth: We have a clear growth framework with defined levels and competencies, so you always know what's expected and what "next" looks like.
Collaboration: Work with teams in sales, marketing, engineering, product, and customer success.
We Live our Values: Be Bold, Be Creative - Lead with Empathy - Act Like an Owner
Flexible working hours and flexible vacation policy
100% Carpe-paid health, dental, and life insurance (Additional benefits at Employee cost)
Full-time permanent positions are eligible for the Carpe Data Bonus Plan.
401k with company matching

Location

We are headquartered in Santa Barbara, CA. We work on a hybrid schedule: Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday in the office.

Salary Range

$155,000 - 180,000. The actual compensation for this role will be determined by a variety of factors, including but not limited to the candidate’s skills, education, experience, and internal equity.

jobs.title: Founding ML Platform Engineer
jobs.description:
About Parisi Labs

Parisi Labs is building foundational world models for physical industry. We are developing models that learn how complex physical systems behave and reuse that understanding across forecasts, scenarios, and operational decisions.

Energy is our first proving ground. We combine historical and live data with operational context, bringing together machine learning research, data infrastructure, and software engineering to turn advances in modeling into useful technology for energy operators.

We are a small technical team working directly with the founders on our core models, systems, and products.

About The Role

We are looking for a Founding ML Platform Engineer to design, build, and own the infrastructure that takes our machine learning models from research into reliable production systems.

You will establish the core MLOps platform at Parisi Labs, creating the tools and workflows that allow researchers to operationalize models without becoming responsible for the infrastructure around them. This includes model registries, dataset and experiment lineage, retraining workflows, scheduled batch inference, and production monitoring.

Our models operate on complex, time-dependent data, producing forecasts and simulations of physical systems. You will build the infrastructure that makes these workflows reproducible, observable, and dependable as our research and products evolve.

This is a hands-on founding engineering role with significant technical ownership. You will work directly with our CTO, Chief Scientist, and researchers to define the platform architecture, select technologies, and implement the systems the company will build on.

What You'll Own

Design and build our end-to-end MLOps platform, from model registration and versioning through deployment, inference, and monitoring.
Develop reliable, scalable batch inference infrastructure for recurring forecasts and model-generated simulations.
Build model registries and lineage systems that track training inputs, dataset versions, model configurations, artifacts, and deployment history.
Create standardized workflows and tools that allow researchers to register models, manage experiments, and move models into production.
Develop automated retraining and deployment pipelines, including dataset preparation, validation, version promotion, and rollback.
Build monitoring and observability for model performance, forecast accuracy, data drift, pipeline health, and production failures.
Help steer the technical and research direction of the company.

What we're looking for

6+ years of software engineering experience, including significant hands-on experience building and operating production ML systems.
A track record of designing and owning ML infrastructure or MLOps platforms, ideally having built systems from the ground up.
Strong Python and backend engineering skills, with experience building reliable data processing and distributed workflow systems.
Experience with ML lifecycle tooling such as MLflow, orchestration frameworks such as Dagster, Airflow, or Prefect, and modern cloud infrastructure.
Deep familiarity with model deployment, batch inference, model versioning, data lineage, and production monitoring.
Comfort working closely with ML researchers and translating experimental workflows into reliable engineering systems.
An entrepreneurial mindset, strong technical ownership, and the ability to operate independently in a fast-moving environment with limited structure.

Especially compelling backgrounds:

Experience as a founder, technical co-founder, or founding engineer at an early-stage startup.
Experience building an ML platform from zero to production, rather than exclusively maintaining established infrastructure.
Experience as an early technical hire who helped establish engineering architecture, tooling, and practices.
Experience with time-series forecasting, energy systems, or other data-intensive scientific applications.

At CVS Health®, you’ll be surrounded by passionate colleagues who care deeply, innovate with purpose, hold ourselves accountable and prioritize safety and quality in everything we do. jobs.title: AI Researcher (Remote)
jobs.description:
The application window is expected to close on: 01/24/2027

This position is hybrid in the Bay Area, New York City, or Seattle, WA. Fully remote candidates within the USA will also be considered.

Meet the Tea m

The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to confidently deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.

Your Impact

You will independently own applied research problems that help organizations understand, evaluate, and improve AI agents across complete workflows. Your work will span agent evaluation, behavioral failure discovery, agent understanding, simulation, and optimization. You will develop novel algorithms and research methods, validate them through rigorous experimentation, and build generalizable AI solutions that balance quality, latency, and cost. You will construct datasets and benchmarks, incorporate human judgment, and validate ideas through controlled experiments, strong baselines, ablations, and systematic error analysis. Working with researchers, Product, Engineering, and customers, you will take an important research problem from hypothesis to a reproducible result and a useful product capability.

Key Responsibilities Will Include

Independently lead applied research workstreams, from hypothesis development and dataset preparation through model training, evaluation, and implementation.
Train and fine-tune small language models (SLMs) using supervised fine-tuning (SFT), parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA, and other post-training techniques.
Develop and curate large-scale training datasets using real-world data, simulation, and synthetic data generation, including establishing labeling guidelines, analyzing annotation disagreements, and validating data quality.
Research and implement improvements to training objectives, data mixtures, sampling strategies, and model adaptation methods, including applying approaches from research literature and developing new methods.
Design and execute controlled experiments, baseline comparisons, and ablation studies to evaluate model performance, robustness, generalization, and failure modes.
Develop reproducible model training and evaluation pipelines, documenting methodologies and findings to support continued research and product development.
Collaborate with Product Management and Engineering to evaluate model behavior, address deployment constraints, and integrate validated research methods into production workflows.
Communicate technical findings through research code, experimental reports, model documentation, and discussions with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Collaborate with global teams and customers, including occasional meetings outside standard local business hours to accommodate different time zones.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning/Artificial Intelligence, Mathematics, or a related field with 8+ years of related experience, or a Master's degree with 6+ years of related experience, or a PhD with 3+ years of related experience.
Experience applying machine learning or AI research to deployed products or practical business problems, including independently leading research workstreams from problem definition through experimentation, evaluation, and implementation.
Experience training and fine-tuning encoder or decoder transformer models using supervised fine-tuning (SFT) or parameter-efficient methods such as LoRA.
Experience developing machine learning solutions using Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, TensorFlow, or equivalent, including model training, optimization, and evaluation.
Experience developing and evaluating machine learning datasets, including data sourcing, curation, labeling, synthetic or simulation-based data generation, and experimental validation.

Preferred Qualifications

Master's degree or PhD in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related field.
Experience designing and executing controlled experiments, including baseline comparisons, ablation studies, leakage prevention, statistical analysis, and systematic error analysis.
Contributions to novel modeling, training, evaluation, or data generation methods demonstrated through research publications, open-source implementations, or documented experimental results.
Experience with advanced model training techniques, including preference optimization, contrastive learning, multi-task learning, or other approaches beyond supervised fine-tuning.
Experience developing simulation and synthetic data pipelines, optimizing data diversity and difficulty, or improving annotation consistency and label quality.
Experience with distributed model training, efficient processing of large datasets, or optimization of model training and inference performance.

Why Cisco?

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
