jobs.title: Senior Research Scientist - HPC & AI
jobs.description:
Requisition Id 17454

Overview

The Analytics and AI methods at Scale (AAIMS) group in the National Center for Computational Science (NCCS) is hiring Senior Research Scientist to push the frontier of AI for science such as: scientific reasoning, federated & collaborative learning, and reinforcement learning (RL) for self-improving models on leadership-class supercomputers. You’ll help design, train, and evaluate AI systems that plan, reason, and take actions to accelerate discovery across domains (materials, chemistry, climate, fusion, biology, and more).

NCCS operates the Frontier exascale supercomputer and world-class data facilities. This role sits at the intersection of AI at scale and HPC, giving you unmatched resources to prototype new ideas, run large ablations, and translate methods into scientific impact.

Examples Of Focus Areas

Agentic AI for Science: Autonomous and tool-using agents for experiment design, simulation steering, data collection, and lab/compute orchestration; planning and memory; multi-agent collaboration.
Scientific Reasoning: Program/path-of-thought, tool-augmented and retrieval-augmented reasoning; uncertainty quantification and calibrated decisions.
RL & Self-Improving Models: RLHF/RLAIF, online RL, self-play, open-ended discovery, reward modeling, curriculum/active learning, data selection, iterative post-training, safety alignment and guardrails.
Foundation Models for Science @ Scale: Pretraining, instruction tuning, continued pretraining, Mixture-of-Experts; distributed training/inference (FSDP, DeepSpeed, Megatron-LM, tensor/sequence parallelism); scalable evaluation pipelines for reasoning and agents.
Federated & Collaborative Learning: Cross-silo training across institutions and facilities; privacy-preserving learning (secure aggregation, differential privacy, MPC/HE); personalization under heterogeneity; governance-aware data/model sharing; collaborative evaluation.

The NCCS is the home of the world’s first exascale supercomputer Frontier. Our Leadership Computing Program (OLCF) provides world class computing facilities to applications across all computational domains and disciplines. We are an inclusive dynamic environment that welcomes those with initiative and creativity.

Major Duties/Responsibilities

At T-Mobile, we invest in YOU! Our Total Rewards Package ensures that employees get the same big love we give our customers. Are you ready to join the Un-carrier movement?

The Engineer, Forward Deployment is a hands-on technical practitioner who embeds within a T-Mobile business unit to design, build, and iterate on net-new agentic AI solutions. These solutions are developed against requirements defined and scoped by TPMs and business unit stakeholders. Forward Deployment Engineers (FDEs) write code, run experiments, debug production systems, and work closely with business unit stakeholder teams to deliver AI solutions that achieve stated business outcomes.

FDEs typically work alongside a Senior FDE who owns the domain relationship and sets technical direction. The Engineer is responsible for the execution layer: building system integrations, tuning prompts, running A/B cohorts, and delivering against validated ROI targets for the domain. Performance is measured by contribution to validated return on investment outcomes for each domain assignment — not by activity or ticket volume. This role reports to the Manager or Senior Manager, Forward Deployment Engineer within the assigned pod.

We pride ourselves on fostering a culture of innovation, advocating for agile methodologies, and promoting transparency in all that we do. Join us in embodying the spirit of the 'Un-carrier' and make a tangible impact! If you're up to the challenge, apply today!

Job Responsibilities:

AI System Deployment & Tuning: Implement, configure, and iteratively tune net-new agentic AI solutions deployed in the assigned business domain, working against requirements defined and delivered by TPMs. Adapt solution behavior, prompt layers, and escalation logic based on live operational feedback on a weekly cycle.
A/B Experimentation & ROI Validation: Run controlled A/B experiments in live production cohorts and document measured impact on validated return on investment targets for the domain. Feed results back to the FDE team and practice leadership with structured analysis to inform delivery prioritization.
BU Partnership & Workflow Engagement: Work directly alongside BU teams in the assigned domain across care, retail, finance, supply chain, or other operational contexts. Observe real workflows, identify friction that AI solutions can address, and conduct structured feedback sessions with BU managers and end users.
Data Engineering & System Integrations: Build system integrations connecting AI solutions to BU data sources such as CRM, billing, ticketing, and ERP platforms. Prepare and normalize business-unit-specific data for AI system consumption. Build lightweight ETL pipelines feeding operational data into evaluation loops and monitoring dashboards. Identify and escalate data quality gaps with specific documentation.
Practice Reporting & Requirements Support: Contribute to reporting cycles that support the TPM-defined requirements pipeline. Document system performance, failure modes, and gaps in a structured format that supports domain planning and delivery prioritization. Participate in practice reviews to share domain learnings.
Contributes structured documentation: failure modes, edge cases, performance gaps, and develops them into practice reporting cycles.
Participates in rotation planning and knowledge transfer sessions.
Contributes to peer knowledge sharing
Supports onboarding of rotating FDEs at the IC level.
Implements integrations and data normalization pipelines for assigned BU data sources. Flags data quality issues and raises to Sr. FDE or TPM.
Builds and iterates on assigned components of agentic systems, individual agents, RAG pipelines, prompt layers, while under architectural direction.
Delivers A/B experiments and documents results.

Education and Work Experience:

Highly Desired: Current or recent experience as a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) within the startup ecosystem, preferably in a fast-paced, high-growth technology or AI-focused company, with demonstrated experience delivering customer-facing technical solutions.
Bachelor's Degree Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field. Relevant equivalent experience accepted. (Required)
2-4+ years hands-on software or ML engineering experience in production environments. Demonstrated ability to write clean, maintainable Python code and to debug and extend existing codebases. Experience deploying to cloud environments and building system integrations with enterprise data sources. (Required)
4-7+ years prior experience in a customer-facing, operations, or embedded technical role (care, retail, finance, supply chain). Exposure to enterprise AI platforms such as Salesforce Einstein, ServiceNow AI, or Microsoft Copilot. (Preferred)

Required Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:

Python Engineering: Python proficiency in production settings: clean, maintainable code; able to read, debug, and extend existing agentic system code written by others.
LLM Integration: Working knowledge of LLM integration patterns: prompt engineering, RAG basics, function calling; experience with at least one major LLM provider.
Data Engineering & System Integrations: SQL proficiency; experience building system integrations connecting AI solutions to enterprise data sources (CRM, ticketing, ERP, billing); able to build lightweight ETL/ELT pipelines and instrument systems with basic logging.
Cloud & DevOps Literacy: Comfortable deploying to AWS or Azure, using Docker, and reading CI/CD pipelines.
Operational Bias to Action: Ships iterative improvements in days, not weeks; able to communicate technical trade-offs clearly to non-technical partners.
Data Security & Responsible AI: Solid understanding of data privacy requirements in enterprise environments including PII and customer data protection. Applies responsible AI principles and appropriate data handling practices when building system integrations and AI solutions.
Forward Deployment Mentality: Demonstrated ability to embed within a business unit, earn stakeholder trust rapidly, and deliver working AI systems under real operational constraints, not in sandbox or lab environments.
Stakeholder Translation: Ability to move fluidly between technical implementation and business communication, converting engineering tradeoffs into plain-language impact narratives for BU managers, and converting vague business asks into precise engineering requirements.
Rapid Prototyping & Production Readiness: Experience compressing the gap between proof-of-concept and production-grade delivery.
At least 18 years of age
Legally authorized to work in the United States

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
we rely on insightful data to power our systems and solutions. We’re seeking an experienced data scientist to deliver insights on a daily basis. The ideal candidate will have mathematical and statistical expertise, along with natural curiosity and a creative mind. While mining, interpreting, and cleaning our data, this person will be relied on to ask questions, connect the dots, and uncover hidden opportunities for realizing the data full potential. As part of a team of specialists, the data scientist will “slice and dice” data using various methods and create new visions for the future.

Objectives of this role

Collaborate with product design and engineering teams to develop an understanding of needs
Research and devise innovative statistical models for data analysis
Communicate findings to all stakeholders
Enable smarter business processes by using analytics for meaningful insights
Keep current with technical and industry developments

Responsibilities

Serve as lead data strategist to identify and integrate new datasets that can be leveraged through our product capabilities, and work closely with the engineering team in the development of data products
Execute analytical experiments to help solve problems across various domains and industries
Identify relevant data sources and sets to mine for client business needs, and collect large structured and unstructured datasets and variables
Devise and utilize algorithms and models to mine big-data stores; perform data and error analysis to improve models; clean and validate data for uniformity and accuracy
Analyze data for trends and patterns, and interpret data with clear objectives in mind
Implement analytical models in production by collaborating with software developers and machine-learning engineers

Required Skills And Qualifications

Seven or more years of experience in data science
Proficiency with data mining, mathematics, and statistical analysis
Advanced experience in pattern recognition and predictive modeling
Experience with Excel, PowerPoint, Tableau, SQL, and programming languages (ex: Java/Python, SAS)
Ability to work effectively in a dynamic, research-oriented group that has several concurrent projects

jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer — Global Health & AI (REMOTE ROLE)
jobs.description:
Description

Applied AI Engineer — Global Health & AI

ICF's Global Health and Development (GHD) line of business, part of the Health, People, and Human Services (HPHS) Group, is seeking an Applied AI Engineer
to build frontier-model systems for various global health and survey programs. This role will support the development of AI-enabled tools that draft survey reports, let researchers and policymakers analyze data in natural language, translate questionnaires into low-resource languages, and support interviewers and data quality in the field. No tool is adopted unless it matches or beats the expert-led process it replaces. You will build the prompting, agent, and pipeline layer across the program. You will also build the evaluation harnesses that show whether each tool actually works, judged against ground truth produced by some of the most experienced survey methodologists in the world.

This position can be remote within the United States, with occasional travel.

It is contingent upon award of program funding.

Key Responsibilities

jobs.description:
About The Role

The Red Hat North America Technology Sales team is looking for an AI Platform Specialist Solution Architect (SSA) to join our team. This position assumes a crucial role in providing expert deep technical sales support for the seamless execution of Go-To-Market (GTM) strategies related to Red Hat AI within North American Your primary focus will be to remove organizational, technical, and competitive blockers of adoption within key accounts to become the preferred AI platform for workloads and applications across the business and help our customers leverage their proprietary data to gain a sustainable advantage over their competitors by helping them train, build, and manage applications that rely on these models.

You will need to be able to confidently articulate our value proposition to leadership, data scientists, developers, and IT teams within the account. This will entail technical architecture walk-throughs, business-value conversations, customer-facing technical workshops, and implementation of best practices in AI systems implementation and design.

You will work closely with the AI business unit and engineering, helping to test, document, and demonstrate cutting-edge features. You will also work in close collaboration with Red Hat customer sales, Customer Success, Consulting Services, and partner teams to ensure a highly positive customer experience.

What You Will Do

Work with the customer Account Executive, Sales Specialist, and Solution Architect to identify challenges and blockers to drive Red Hat AI within new and existing customer accounts
Plan, design, and execute AI systems with customers having the ability to architect and build data pipelines, ML pipelines, and ML training and serving approaches leveraging additional support and resources from Red Hat as required
Facilitate pre, and post-sales activities when needed, including technical deep dives, proofs of concept, “bake-offs,” internal sprints and hackathons, and development of partner vertical-specific AI solutions to drive adoption of Red Hat AI
Identify and partner with AI customer stakeholders, acting as an advocate within both their line-of-business and internal customer teams
Work closely with the AI business unit and engineering teams, providing a market feedback loop on the product and solutions
Execute community outreach and customer advocacy activities including conference speaking, blog posts, etc

What You Will Bring

Kubernetes & Container Platform Expertise: 4+ years of hands-on experience architecting, deploying, and managing production-grade containerized environments, with deep technical expertise in Kubernetes. Solid understanding of cluster operations, software-defined networking, persistent storage, and cluster security.
Infrastructure for AI/ML Workloads: Proven experience configuring, optimizing, and scheduling containerized workloads on Kubernetes, specifically involving specialized hardware resource management (such as GPU scheduling, NVIDIA Operators, or Multi-Instance GPU configuration).
Practical experience in one of the following areas:
Machine Learning Use Case Development, including:
building AI applications (e.g., deep learning, LLM/RAG, NLP, computer vision, or pattern recognition).
Practical experience with a statistical programming language (e.g., Python), applied machine learning techniques, and using OSS frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch).

Machine Learning Operations design, including:
Previous successful experience in AI systems design, with the ability to architect and explain data pipelines, ML pipelines, and ML training and serving approaches.

Experience with CI/CD solutions in the context of MLOps and LLMOps including automation with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) solutions (e.g. Ansible).
Experience delivering technical presentations and leading business value sessions.
Executive presence with public speaking skills

Nice To Have

Computer Science or similar degree
Previous experience as a sales engineer, technical sales, or similar role preferably at an enterprise software company, a SaaS company, or Systems Integrator
Previous experience as an implementation consultant for AI solutions
Previous experience in Machine Learning Use Case Development and Operations experience
Industry vertical experience with Data Science projects. i.e. - expertise in FSI, medical, defense, and intelligence verticals
Community brand in volunteer tech communities like AI Users Group or open-source projects

The salary range for this position is $172,020.00 - $275,360.00 (inclusive of base pay + target incentive compensation). Actual offer will be based on your qualifications.

Pay Transparency

Red Hat determines compensation based on several factors including but not limited to job location, experience, applicable skills and training, external market value, and internal pay equity. Annual salary is one component of Red Hat’s compensation package. This position may also be eligible for bonus, commission, and/or equity. For positions with Remote-US locations, the actual salary range for the position may differ based on location but will be commensurate with job duties and relevant work experience.

About Red Hat

Red Hat is the world’s leading provider of enterprise open source software solutions, using a community-powered approach to deliver high-performing Linux, cloud, container, and Kubernetes technologies. Spread across 40+ countries, our associates work flexibly across work environments, from in-office, to office-flex, to fully remote, depending on the requirements of their role. Red Hatters are encouraged to bring their best ideas, no matter their title or tenure. We're a leader in open source because of our open and inclusive environment. We hire creative, passionate people ready to contribute their ideas, help solve complex problems, and make an impact.

Benefits

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage
Flexible Spending Account - healthcare and dependent care
Health Savings Account - high deductible medical plan
Retirement 401(k) with employer match
Paid time off and holidays
Paid parental leave plans for all new parents
Leave benefits including disability, paid family medical leave, and paid military leave
Additional benefits including employee stock purchase plan, family planning reimbursement, tuition reimbursement, transportation expense account, employee assistance program, and more!

Note:
These benefits are only applicable to full time, permanent associates at Red Hat located in the United States.

Inclusion at Red Hat

Red Hat’s culture is built on the open source principles of transparency, collaboration, and inclusion, where the best ideas can come from anywhere and anyone. When this is realized, it empowers people from different backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences to come together to share ideas, challenge the status quo, and drive innovation. Our aspiration is that everyone experiences this culture with equal opportunity and access, and that all voices are not only heard but also celebrated. We hope you will join our celebration, and we welcome and encourage applicants from all the beautiful dimensions that compose our global village.

Equal Opportunity Policy (EEO)

Red Hat is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer. We review applications for employment without regard to their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, veteran status, genetic information, physical or mental disability, medical condition, marital status, or any other basis prohibited by law.

Red Hat does not seek or accept unsolicited resumes or CVs from recruitment agencies. We are not responsible for, and will not pay, any fees, commissions, or any other payment related to unsolicited resumes or CVs except as required in a written contract between Red Hat and the recruitment agency or party requesting payment of a fee.

Red Hat supports individuals with disabilities and provides reasonable accommodations to job applicants. jobs.description:
Company Intro

At Toloka AI
we create data that powers leading GenAI models and innovations. We work with frontier labs, big tech, renowned AI startups, enterprises and non-profit research organizations worldwide. We use a combination of Experts + Crowd + Tech Platform to teach AI models to reason and evaluate their efficacy and safety. We have experts in more than 50 different domains - from doctors and lawyers to physicists and engineers - and boast one of the most diverse global crowds, representing over
100 countries and speaking 40+ languages
. We are a well-funded startup with an enviable portfolio of clients including Anthropic
, Amazon
, Microsoft
, Poolside
, Recraft
, and Shopify
.

Recently, we secured strategic investment led by Bezos Expeditions
and Nebius Group
with participation from Mikhail Parakhin
, CTO of Shopify
and board advisor to leading GenAI companies, who now serves as our Chairman of the Board. Our remote-first team is globally distributed around the world: USA
, UK
, the Netherlands
, Serbia
, and more.

About position

The Freelance Forward Deployed AI Engineer
is Toloka's most senior client-facing technical role. You will partner directly with CTOs, VPs of Engineering and ML, research leaders, and applied AI teams, helping them solve complex AI data challenges and translate ambitious model goals into practical, scalable solutions.

This is a hands-on role
. You will design and build the data-generation
, labeling
, and evaluation pipelines t
hat power the next generation of AI models
. Rather than training the models yourself, you'll help clients identify the right data strategy and own the solution from problem discovery through implementation and delivery.

Beyond delivering client solutions, you'll help shape how Toloka approaches AI solution engineering - establishing best practices, raising the technical bar across engagements, and mentoring Solution Engineers
and Technical Consultants
.

Why this role is different

Every engagement is different. One week you might be designing evaluation pipelines for frontier foundation models, the next helping an enterprise build domain-specific reasoning datasets or synthetic data workflows.

This role sits at the intersection of consulting, engineering, and AI. You'll work directly with some of the world's leading AI companies, helping shape how next-generation models are trained and evaluated.

What you'll do

Executive partnership

Act as the primary technical counterpart to CTOs, VPs of Engineering, and research/engineering leadership.
Lead executive conversations using a structured, answer-first (BLUF) approach.
Manage escalations and expectations with composure and integrity.
Build long-term trusted relationships by recommending evidence-based solutions.

Data strategy & needs diagnosis

Ask excellent questions to uncover the client's real need - the "question behind the question." Understand their model, which metrics they want to move, and how they intend to train or evaluate it.
Draw on a solid understanding of how LLMs are trained and fine-tuned
to have credible conversations with their technical leaders, understand their data strategy, and proactively propose the data
that will solve their problem - with options and rationale ("based on your goal, you likely need this, or this").

Solution engineering & delivery (hands-on)

Design and build the data solutions yourself:
configure data-labeling components and quality controls, develop user interfaces and AI-driven solutions (e.g. agentic systems, RAG, synthetic data generation), and integrate them into automated, multi-stage pipelines
that produce data for AI training and evaluation.
Architect and reason about complex, multi-stage solutions
end to end; run experiments to prove the pipeline delivers data of the required quality and speed; iterate from MVP toward production.
Provide technical leadership across multiple client engagements, establish reusable engineering standards and best practices, and mentor Solution Engineers and Technical Consultants to raise the overall technical bar of the organization.

Commercial ownership

Own delivery end to end
- timelines
, quality
, and scalability
- and the commercial outcome
: Gross Margin and Contribution Margin, with the levers, trade-offs, and next checkpoints named, not just described.
Identify and drive expansion opportunities.

About You

Executive communication.
You can confidently lead conversations with CTOs, VPs, and senior technical stakeholders - clear, concise, structured, persuasive, and calm under pressure.
Strong understanding of modern LLM development.
You understand how modern LLMs are trained, fine-tuned, and evaluated (including SFT, RLHF/RLAIF, DPO/PPO, reward modeling, and LoRA/PEFT). You're comfortable discussing these topics with senior technical stakeholders and translating their goals into effective AI data solutions.
Hands-on solution engineering.
You've designed complex AI solutions, built multi-stage pipelines, and developed AI-driven systems (e.g. agentic workflows, RAG, or synthetic data generation). You're comfortable working in Python (NumPy, Pandas), integrating APIs, and independently prototyping LLM-powered solutions.
Solid software engineering foundations.
You understand version control, testing, MVP thinking, and iterative development. Experience building production software is a strong plus.
Exceptional discovery and problem framing.
You enjoy working through ambiguity, asking the right questions, and translating business or research goals into clear AI data and evaluation strategies.
Seniority and track record.
8+ years delivering complex AI, ML, or data projects end to end, with experience influencing technical direction beyond individual projects. Experience establishing engineering standards, mentoring engineers, or leading cross-functional technical initiatives is highly valued. Experience in top-tier strategy consulting (McKinsey, Bain, BCG) and/or as an applied ML / LLM engineer is a strong advantage.
Ownership mindset.
You take responsibility for outcomes, make thoughtful trade-offs between time, cost, and quality, and are comfortable owning both technical and commercial success.

Nice to have

Hands-on experience training or fine-tuning LLMs and/or building agentic systems (helps you reason about client needs - though the role itself is about building data solutions, not training models).
Advanced degree (MSc/PhD) in AI, CS, or a related field.
Experience in crowdsourcing and/or data-centric AI, and with fast-paced, multi-project delivery for frontier AI clients.

What we can offer

Full-time independent contractor engagement
through the Ontop contractor platform
, either as an individual or through your own company or business entity;
Flexible, fully remote schedule ( 40 hours per week
);
Work at the leading edge of AI development, alongside a dedicated and dynamic team of experts;
Projects with customers that are AI industry leaders and well-known household names;
Friendly community.

jobs.title: Enterprise AI Architecture Consultant
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Accenture Song Service helps leading brands turn customer interactions into an engine for growth, moving service beyond a cost center to something that builds trust, loyalty, and share of wallet. Our Service practice works end to end: we shape the vision and strategy for the service function and help clients implement and run it, innovate the products and services customers rely on, equip client customer service and customer experience teams with the right technology and talent, and turn customer data into insights that strengthen client’s relationship with their customers.

Service AI & Data puts AI at the heart of this work. We help clients reinvent how they serve their customers and support their people: conversational AI and AI agents that resolve customer needs across voice, chat, and messaging; copilots that help service agents and field teams do their best work; and the data foundations, data lakes, reporting, and analytics agents that turn every interaction into insight. The strategies we shape and the experiences we design are delivered into production at enterprise scale.

Who You Are

You are a Forward Deployed Engineer who brings an architectural perspective to integrating AI across complex enterprise systems. You embed directly with clients to connect AI components and cooperating AI agents with the platforms customer service runs on (CRM, contact center, knowledge, telephony, and data), and you build the integrations and reusable patterns that let AI scale across a client's service ecosystem.

You are a builder who is just as comfortable in a client workshop as in a code editor. You thrive in fast-moving, ambiguous environments, moving between engagements, picking up new platforms quickly, and explaining technical choices in plain language to engineers and business stakeholders alike. Above all, you are a curious, collaborative teammate who makes the people around you better.

The Work

Embed with client teams, on site and remote, to understand how their service operation really works, from contact center and agent workflows to the systems and data behind them.
Join discovery workshops with client business and technology teams, helping identify, size, and prioritize the AI use cases with the highest impact on customers and the business.
Build rapid prototypes that prove how AI agents can plug into a client's service ecosystem, often within days, before a full build begins.
Design and build integrations that connect AI agents to CRM, contact center, knowledge management, ticketing, telephony, and enterprise data platforms through APIs, events, platform-native connectors, and tool-use patterns such as MCP.
Design how multiple AI agents coordinate across systems, including which agent owns which task, which systems each one can access, and how requests are routed between them.
Map and build the data flows between platforms, so customer, order, case, and interaction data move reliably and securely between AI agents and the systems of record.
Connect AI agents to systems through event-driven patterns, so they can react in real time to moments like a delayed order, a failed payment, or an escalated case.
Build the human handoff and escalation flows that pass full customer context from AI agents to human agents across voice, chat, and messaging.
Carry customer identity and context across channels, so a customer who starts in chat and moves to voice never has to start over, whether they are talking to an AI agent or a person.
Harden integrations for production with testing, logging, observability, and CI/CD, and document integration specifications, reference architectures, and reusable patterns for the wider team.
Bring conversation designs, customer experience journeys, and prototypes to life in code, flagging technical constraints early and iterating quickly as designs evolve and as real usage data comes in.
Support production rollout and adoption: write runbooks, train client teams on new AI-powered workflows, and help deliver a clean handoff to client or managed-delivery teams.
Use AI-assisted engineering tools every day across story grooming, solutioning, testing and triage, and development to raise the speed and quality of delivery.
Contribute reusable components, accelerators, and lessons learned from the field so our teams deliver faster on the next engagement.
Help onboard and mentor junior teammates, and contribute to project debriefs and team POVs.

Here's What You'll Need

3+ years of professional experience in software engineering, data or platform engineering, or a client-facing technical role such as solutions engineering, technical consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering. Experience should include hands-on experience building and deploying AI or LLM-powered applications, ideally integrated with real enterprise systems rather than prototypes or demos only.
1+ years of experience working on customer service, contact center, or customer experience projects or operations, with an understanding of the metrics that matter there, such as containment, first-contact resolution, average handle time, and CSAT.
3+ years of experience programming skills in Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, or Java, plus SQL for querying data and validating pipelines.
Willingness to travel regularly to client locations.

Bonus Points If You Have

Hands-on experience with API and enterprise system integration, including REST and GraphQL APIs, webhooks, authentication and identity (such as OAuth), and event-driven or messaging patterns.
Hands-on experience integrating with enterprise platforms, ideally customer service platforms such as Salesforce Service Cloud, ServiceNow, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Genesys Cloud, NICE CXone, or Amazon Connect, including their data models and platform-native connectors.
Working knowledge of how AI agents call tools and external systems, including tool-use patterns such as MCP, on at least one enterprise agent platform such as Amazon Bedrock AgentCore, Microsoft Azure AI Foundry, or Google Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform.
Experience deploying on at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud).
The ability to translate technical work into clear business value, and to communicate with everyone from developers to client leaders.
Comfort working in ambiguous, fast-moving environments with changing client requirements.
Exposure to conversational AI across voice and digital channels, such as IVR modernization, chat and messaging, or intelligent routing.
Experience with integration platforms or event streaming, such as MuleSoft or Kafka.
Associate-level cloud certifications, such as AWS Certified Solutions Architect – Associate or Microsoft Certified: Azure AI Engineer Associate.
A portfolio of real-world AI projects or deployed solutions you can walk us through.
Experience with client-facing projects, ideally in consulting, agency, or other professional services.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), AWS Forward Deployed Engineering, US Government
jobs.description:
Description

Application deadline: Nov 17, 2026

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility or higher.

A Forward Deployed Engineer II (FDE II) embeds directly inside a strategic enterprise customer to independently design, build, deploy, and run AI-powered production systems alongside the customer's engineering team. FDE IIs write production-grade software and own delivery of complete AI workstreams end-to-end — from requirements gathering through production deployment — combining the technical rigor of an AWS SDE with the urgency and ownership required to deliver measurable customer business outcomes.

FDE IIs are autonomous contributors. They deliver working features spanning the full software lifecycle. They design cohesive implementations for ambiguous problems, making design trade-offs with appropriate guidance. They take on projects where the business problem is understood but implementations are not fully fleshed out, balancing constraints and limiting short-term workarounds. They coach others on producing high-quality code and train new team members.

Key job responsibilities

Embed within customer engineering teams. Work with customers, stakeholders, and peers to understand the business and customer value of the systems you build. Understand the customer's business processes, technical architecture, and operational constraints. Translate customer requirements into technical designs for AI-enabled production systems within your workstream. Requires 30 – 50% travel.
Build production AI applications. Design and develop production-grade software powering AI and agentic workflows — retrieval pipelines, workflow automation, API orchestration layers, data integration. Solve difficult problems with visible risks or roadblocks, bringing clarity and identifying simple designs for solutions. Integrate foundation models, customer data sources, and existing applications into cohesive AI experiences. Optimize for latency, reliability, and cost.
Own production for your workstream. Be a significant contributor to the full software development lifecycle including scoping, design, code, testing, deployment, operations, and maintenance. Troubleshoot production incidents across AI models, distributed systems, and application services. Ensure root causes of operational issues are identified and resolved. Implement monitoring, evaluations, guardrails, and CI/CD that keep AI systems healthy. Don't settle for the status quo — routinely identify and execute on opportunities to improve operations.
Mentor and uplift. Actively mentors and trains new team members on how systems are constructed, operated, and fit into the bigger picture. Coach others on producing high-quality code through mechanisms such as code review. Be active in the code review process, providing meaningful feedback to others.
Accelerate customer adoption. Identify opportunities to expand AI adoption within your customer engagement. Codify reusable patterns and accelerators that benefit future customer deployments and feed back into AWS services. Make enhancements that improve your team's software and processes.

A day in the life

An FDE II spends the day building inside the customer's environment: pairing with their engineers on production AI features, translating requirements into designs for their workstream, troubleshooting production issues, and reviewing code. They work autonomously on scoped problems, bringing clarity to ambiguous implementations with appropriate guidance from senior FDEs.

Diverse Experiences

Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
Experience with agentic and spec-driven development (developing AI agents a plus)
Experience with AI tools: eval frameworks, agent tooling, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering
Active US Government Top Secret clearance with SCI eligibility (or higher)
2+ years of experience working in an Agile, startup, or rapidly scaling environment

Preferred Qualifications

Experience working with AWS Services
Experience working in customer production environments
Experience building or deploying AI/ML applications in production environments
Background as a founder, engineering lead, or startup builder with high ownership and urgency

6 months to start (with potential for extension or conversion)

Job Description

This engineer is the delivery and mentorship multiplier of the AI engineering team the senior builder who turns architecture into shipped solutions and models engineering craft for early-career teammates.
The role is platform-agnostic by design: what matters is deep, current fluency in building production AI systems agentic workflows, LLM integrations, retrieval patterns, evaluation on whatever stack the problem calls for. Today's estate is Microsoft-centered (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform), but we hire for the engineering, not the vendor.
This person carries the team's most complex builds while raising the bar for everyone around them.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop agentic AI workflows multi-step, multi-tool systems with memory, planning, and human-in-the-loop checkpoints using the frameworks and model providers best suited to each use case
Build and maintain AI-powered solutions for finance and accounting use cases, spanning code-first services and low/no-code platforms as appropriate
Develop Python-based automation and AI integration code well-structured, tested, production-ready
Engineer prompt templates, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) patterns, and evaluation frameworks for enterprise use cases
Connect AI pipelines to ERP and enterprise data REST/OData APIs, data entities, SQL
Pair with and mentor the team's junior engineers; review their designs and code
Contribute to AI architecture decisions and architecture decision records alongside the AI Engineering Lead
Support organization-wide AI adoption demos, office hours, and internal upskilling content

5+ years of software engineering experience with 2+ years in AI engineering or enterprise AI solution delivery
Hands-on experience building against modern LLM APIs (e.g., OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, Google) completions, embeddings, tool/function calling, structured outputs
Experience building agentic systems tool use, memory management, orchestration with one or more frameworks (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, Microsoft Agent Framework, or equivalent in-house patterns)
Proficiency in Python async patterns, API clients, data processing, testing
Experience with RAG architectures vector stores, embedding pipelines, retrieval strategies
Strong ability to write clean, maintainable, production-grade code with test coverage
Effective mentor and collaborator in a distributed team
Preferred Qualifications
Experience with the Microsoft AI stack Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, Copilot Studio, Power Platform

Experience with AI evaluation and observability tooling eval harnesses, tracing, model comparison

You'll partner closely with Product and Engineering to rapidly prototype, build, and deploy intelligent features, applying strong software engineering fundamentals to deliver scalable, reliable, and maintainable solutions. Integrate LLMs and cloud AI services into production applications

Experience building RESTful APIs and backend application services

Excellent collaboration and communication skills

jobs.title: Applied Scientist II, Seller Fee Science
jobs.description:
Description

Amazon’s third-party marketplace is a multibillion-dollar global ecosystem, connecting customers and sellers across the world through millions of transactions annually. The Seller Fee Science Team integrates economic modeling, machine learning, and artificial intelligence to guide business fee strategy, ensure fees are accurately computed for millions of products, and improves the seller experience with AI tools that support any fee related contact (understanding, audit, and dispute). We build the scientific foundation that empowers sellers to grow their businesses with clarity and confidence.

Our team brings together world-class economists, physicists, mathematicians, and computer scientists to tackle diverse challenging problems that require theoretical rigor and deliver real-world impact. For example, precision measurement of difficult to measure products, large-scale simulation of sales, inventory, and policy changes, as well as leveraging natural language understanding and automated reasoning to interpret policy, generate code, resolve disputes, audit fees, and respond to sellers at meaninful scale.

As an applied scientist on our team, this role will focus on the application of machine learning and artificial intelligence to predict and reconcile measurement of products globally. This blends together statistical modeling, application of NLP, image processing, classical machine learning, cost-benefit analysis, causal modeling, and optimization. Your work will shape not only how fees are implemented, but how they are interpreted, experienced, and trusted at scale. You will partner closely with engineers and product partners to take your solutions from research to production.

We are seeking scientists who are motivated by first principles, disciplined experimentation, and the technical challenge of deploying ideas at global scale. This is an opportunity to work on consequential problems where mathematical rigor meets real-world complexity, and where your models, algorithms, and systems will directly influence the experience of millions of sellers. If you are driven to build elegant solutions to hard problems—and to see them operate in production at meaningful scale—we would welcome the opportunity to build with you.

Identify opportunities to improve Seller Experience and translate ambiguous business challenges into well-defined scientific problems with measurable impact.
Design, develop, and deploy AI/ML models that improve fee accuracy, automate policy-to-code translation, and enhance seller understanding of fee calculations.
Partner closely with engineering and product teams to productionize solutions, meeting latency, scalability, reliability, and other system constraints.
Apply rigorous experimentation, causal inference, and simulation methods to validate models and quantify business impact at scale.
Communicate scientific innovations and results clearly to cross-functional stakeholders and contribute to the broader internal and external scientific community through publications, talks, and technical artifacts.

PhD

2+ years of building models for business application experience
Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

Experience with theory and practice of design of experiments and statistical analysis of results

Description

ARCADE is the Science and Analytics team for Amazon Multi-Channel Fulfillment and Commerce (MCCF). ARCADE owns the science behind MCCF's core business decisions. That includes MCF demand forecasting for US and International markets, which feeds capacity planning and OP commitments. It also includes pricing science, from elasticity studies to custom pricing recommendations for enterprise accounts. For Sales and Account Management, we build the merchant retention and propensity models they use to decide which merchants to focus on. We also design and measure experiments for MCCF programs and build models that support ASCS service quality. Each of these runs as a governed mechanism within the business, not a one-off analysis.

In 2027 we're investing into forecasting, measurement and automation. On forecasting, we'll make MCF demand forecasts more accurate and extend regional forecasts to International markets. We'll also build a per-merchant baseline of organic growth. That baseline lets teams measure how much account management actions, product features and discounts actually add, and spot declining merchants early. On automation, we'll automate custom pricing recommendations for enterprise accounts through PRISM. Over the 3-year plan, we'll add cost-to-serve modeling, a supply chain optimizer for inbound placement and routing and a shared framework for monitoring all production models.

Build, deploy and maintain ML and statistical models for MCF demand forecasting, merchant growth, retention and propensity, and pricing

NVIDIA played a key role in launching the modern AI era with GPU-accelerated deep learning. Today, generative AI opens outstanding opportunities—helping people share ideas, gain knowledge, and solve problems once out of reach. Making that promise trustworthy is one of the major scientific challenges today. As a Deep Learning Scientist in AI Safety, you will advance research in model alignment, create methods to reduce harmful behaviors, and transform new insights into practical protections for large language models. Join us to develop how advanced AI interacts with people and help extend its benefits worldwide.

NVIDIA is recruiting Senior Deep Learning Scientists to push forward our work in multimodal AI safety, covering Product Security, Content Safety, Bias, and Human-AI Interactions. You will bring core expertise in deep learning to reinforce models for safe reasoning, planning, and acting across different modalities. This opportunity enables you to contribute essential algorithmic advances for foundational models processing diverse data formats. Your initiatives will reach scale via Nemotron Omni platforms, guardrails, and partnerships outside the organization. You will focus on high-impact, prominent safety challenges of large language models and multimodal AI products that improve user experiences for millions. If you are imaginative and driven to tackle real-world agentic AI safety issues, join our team.

What You Will Be Doing

Apply fundamental and applied safety research to develop, train, fine-tune, and deploy large language architectures supporting multimodal agentic reasoning systems and guardrails encompassing text, audio, image, video, and tool usage.
Advance post-training and alignment methods including instruction tuning, preference optimization, and RLHF/RLVR/MOPD to improve safety of multimodal agents for complex use cases.
Research and advance the latest trends in AI safety as applied to pre-/mid-/post-training, guardrails, and steering techniques.
Lead the collection, development, and benchmarking of multimodal safety datasets, ensuring high-quality evaluation of model accuracy, safety, and task completion success.

What We Need To See

Master’s degree (or equivalent experience) or PhD in Computer Science, AI, or Applied Math with 8+ years of relevant work experience.
Excellent programming skills in Python with strong fundamentals in scalable model development and deep learning frameworks like PyTorch.
Strong knowledge of ML/DL techniques and modern foundation model architectures, including Transformers and mixture-of-experts models.
Hands-on experience in post-training multimodal models for multimodal reasoning.
Proven ability to manage model development life cycles, including dataset versioning, experiment tracking, and evaluation pipelines.
Responsible AI Expertise: 1+ years of experience in content safety, ML fairness, AI model security, human-AI interaction, or related areas.

Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd

Strong record of publications in top-tier AI and machine learning venues such as NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, FAccT, or CVPR.
Experience applying deep reinforcement learning techniques to train multimodal agents in complex simulation.
Safety and Compliance: Proven experience addressing safety and legal and regulatory compliance in multimodal, multilingual, or multi-turn systems.

Experience in at least one of the following risk areas: CBRNE, persuasion and manipulation (influence operations, disinformation, and the erosion of democratic values through AI-generated content), discrimination at scale enabled by AI systems, mental health (sycophancy and manipulation), LLM security (backdoors, data poisoning, latent malicious behavior, structural model vulnerabilities), frontier risks (model deception, manipulation, and loss-of-control scenarios), agentic safety (tool-calling, orchestration, and execution), multi-turn.

jobs.description:
When you join Verizon

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.

What You’ll Be Doing...

As a Principal Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Data Analytics team, you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with total technical ownership, you will architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.

You are a technical anchor: you pair deep systems craftsmanship with a product mindset, cutting through operational ambiguity to design production architectures, implement custom orchestration layers (via LangGraph, Temporal, or custom state machines), and enforce context management strategies that scale into enterprise assets. Beyond shipping point solutions, you will run workloads reliably on Domino, Airflow, and Kubernetes, abstracting bespoke code into reusable SDKs, shared libraries, and architectural playbooks that scale company-wide.

Key Responsibilities Include

End-to-End Architectural Blueprinting: Defining the full-stack architecture for embedded AI initiatives, including multi-agent orchestration, state machines, latency/cost budgets, security boundaries, and enterprise back-end integrations.
Agentic Orchestration Engineering, Workflow Automation and Governance: Architect stateful agent workflows complying with established agentic governance rules, using tools like LangGraph, Temporal, or event-driven state machines, establishing strict protocols for tool calling, execution sandboxing, and deterministic fallback logic.
Context & Retrieval Systems: Designing production RAG infrastructure incorporating hybrid search, re-ranking algorithms, metadata filtering, and semantic caching, directly informing and scaling Verizon’s context architecture.
Runtime & Cloud Deployment: Deploying production agent services and scheduled workflows to target runtimes (e.g., Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes microservices, and serverless compute across AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Evaluation Harness Design: Architecting offline and online evaluation frameworks (e.g., LLM-as-a-judge, synthetic test generation, human-in-the-loop review queues, live A/B rollouts) to measure model drift, context hallucination rates, and task completion metrics.
Platform Codification & IP Creation: Generalizing custom domain deployments into reusable internal SDKs, API primitives, and modular UI components; mentor engineers across the organization and draft technical documentation for Verizon patent disclosures.
Strategic Discovery & Scoping: Embed alongside BU leadership to map intricate operational processes, cut through organizational noise, and isolate the highest-leverage intervention points where applied AI delivers measurable uplift.
Executive Translation: Serving as the technical authority in the room with BU Vice Presidents and Managing Directors, demystifying algorithmic behaviors, failure modes, and performance trade-offs.

What We’re Looking For...

You’ll need to have:

Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
Six or more years of relevant experience required, demonstrated through one or a combination of work and/or military experience, or specialized training.
Extensive hands-on experience leveraging frontier LLMs (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Gemini) and agentic developer frameworks (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot) to build scalable solutions and achieve core business milestones.
Experience with containerized deployments (Docker), API design, and cloud environments (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
Advanced full-stack programming mastery in Python, SQL, and modern JavaScript/TypeScript stacks.
Demonstrated ability to independently scope ambiguous technical initiatives and present architectural designs to senior executive stakeholders.
Demonstrated ability to interface directly with enterprise stakeholders, translate ambiguous business requirements into technical architectures, and lead project delivery end-to-end.

Even Better If You Have

Bachelor's or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Robotics, or a related technical field.
Experience building and scaling centralized context platforms or enterprise search engines similar to Verizon's internal enterprise context layer platforms.
Proven track record implementing both offline evaluation benchmarks and online evaluation/observability pipelines (latency, token costs, hallucination tracking, eval-driven development).
Proven experience deploying containerized services and data workflows across enterprise platforms such as Domino Data Lab, Apache Airflow, Kubernetes (EKS/GKE), and hyperscaler cloud environments (AWS/GCP/Azure).
Proven track record designing offline/online eval harnesses, guardrail frameworks, and observability systems (latency, token optimization, tracing).
Prior forward-deployed engineering, solutions architecture, or technical consulting experience in top-tier technology firms or hyperscalers.
Record of turning one-off operational builds into enterprise-wide shared libraries, with associated technical publications or filed patents.
Domain knowledge in telecommunications, network capacity optimization, capital planning, or large-scale customer care operations.
Deep expertise in retrieval and context architectures: designing production RAG pipelines, vector databases (e.g., pgvector, Milvus, Pinecone), hybrid search (dense + sparse/lexical), and dynamic context management.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

Where you’ll be working

In this hybrid role, you'll have a defined work location that includes working from home and a minimum of three days per week in the office, which will be set by your manager. Employees are responsible for maintaining compliance with hybrid work policies.

jobs.description:
About the Role

As a Principal Recommendation System/Platform Engineer, you will lead the upgrade of our core recommendation architecture and recommendation model platform, transforming our existing rule-based personalization system into an industrial-grade, large-scale, real-time ML recommendation platform. This role spans key business scenarios, including trading products, content feeds, the community, and AI-powered investment workflows such as TradeGPT.
You will work closely with recommendation algorithm, growth product and operations, and data science teams to build a high-throughput, low-latency, highly available foundation for personalization at scale, serving more than 80 million users globally. You will lead architectural decisions, infrastructure development, and end-to-end delivery, taking the platform from zero to one in a resource-constrained, fast-moving environment.

Key Responsibilities

Develop high-throughput, low-latency recommendation services. Continuously improve system performance and reliability, and establish robust degradation and disaster-recovery mechanisms.
Build and optimize large-scale model training infrastructure, including distributed training, job scheduling, resource management, fault recovery, and training observability. Improve training efficiency, stability, and resource utilization.
Build model deployment capabilities and high-performance online inference services. Optimize model loading, inference latency, throughput, and infrastructure cost; implement autoscaling, canary releases, graceful degradation, and disaster recovery to ensure service availability under high traffic.
Establish an engineering feedback loop from offline evaluation and online experimentation to production monitoring. Monitor model quality, service performance, and anomalies; build alerting capabilities to support incident diagnosis and safe rollback.
Collaborate with recommendation algorithm and business engineering teams to identify common needs across trading products, content feeds, community, and other recommendation scenarios. Standardize training, deployment, and inference capabilities to bring models into production reliably and efficiently.

Major Requirements

At least 4 years of recommender systems engineering experience at a consumer-facing internet company. You have contributed substantially to the design and development of a model training platform, model deployment platform, or large-scale online inference service, and have hands-on experience resolving production issues.
Strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in at least one of Go, Java, or C++. You write well-structured code, apply sound design principles, and enjoy tackling challenging engineering problems.
Familiarity with at least one mainstream deep learning framework, such as PyTorch or TensorFlow. You understand the end-to-end workflow of training, exporting, deploying, and serving recommendation models, and have practical experience with distributed training or training job orchestration.
An understanding of the recommendation system lifecycle and the engineering considerations involved in sequence models, multi-objective models, and other recommender model types. You can work with algorithm teams to turn model requirements into reusable, maintainable production platform capabilities.
Experience designing and optimizing high-throughput, low-latency services. You can diagnose and resolve online inference issues involving throughput, P99 latency, reliability, and resource cost.

Nice-to-have:

Architecture experience in search, advertising, or recommendations at major technology companies
Experience leading the development of a training platform, model deployment platform, or online inference pipeline from the ground up in a large-scale recommendation, advertising, or search system, and making those capabilities reusable across business scenarios.
Experience optimizing distributed training or inference for complex recommendation models, or scheduling heterogeneous CPU/GPU resources.
Experience with cross-region high-availability deployments, active-active architectures, model release governance, or large-scale production incident response.
An AI-driven approach and hands-on experience bringing LLM or agent applications into production for search, advertising, or recommendation use cases.

Why Join Us

A multi-domain recommendation challenge in fintech:
Go beyond a single domain such as video or e-commerce. You will build personalization capabilities across trading products, market intelligence, community content, campaigns, and AI-powered investment workflows.
Proven business impact with substantial room for ML advancement:
Our current recommendation system has demonstrated a 71% increase in CTR and a 1,285% increase in conversion rate, with significant potential for an ML-native upgrade.
Work at the intersection of AI and recommendations:
Build where traditional recommender systems, generative AI, and LLM agents meet—one of the most active frontiers in engineering.
An opportunity to lead, not just follow:
Our combination of trading, content, community, AI, and campaigns creates distinctive technical challenges and enables rapid iteration.
Global scale:
Serve more than 80 million users across over 200 countries, tackling the real-world complexity of large-scale, real-time systems.

You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. As a Principal Forward Deployed AI Engineer within Verizon’s Data Analytics team, you will embed directly into the frontline of Verizon’s core Business Units to solve our most critical, ambiguous, and high-stakes operational challenges. Operating with total technical ownership, you will architect, build, and deploy production-grade agentic systems, enterprise RAG engines, full-stack microservices, and decision systems into live operations.

jobs.description:
Description

We are seeking a Forward Deployed Software Engineer to build technology solutions that help public health programs operate more effectively. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone who enjoys working directly with users, understanding complex operational problems, and turning them into reliable software that delivers measurable value.

As an embedded member of a cross-functional team, you will partner with program staff, technical assistance providers, product teams, engineers, and client stakeholders. You will help uncover needs, shape solutions, build and test them with users, and take successful capabilities into production. The role combines full-stack software engineering, workflow automation, data integration, and applied AI in an environment where requirements evolve as teams learn.

You will be successful if you are equally comfortable writing production code, talking with users, working through ambiguity, and making pragmatic technical decisions.

Responsibilities

Discover and define:
Work directly with program teams, client stakeholders, and end users to understand operational challenges, identify opportunities for technology, and translate loosely defined problems into practical technical solutions.

Prototype and build:
Design and build across the full stack, including user experiences, application services, APIs, relational data models, integrations, workflows, dashboards, and reporting. Move quickly from problem definition to working prototypes and iterate with real user feedback.

Apply AI where it adds value:
Build AI-assisted capabilities such as summarization, structured extraction, classification, and workflow support. Preserve appropriate human review and account for reliability, privacy, data governance, and responsible use.

Deploy and improve:
Move successful capabilities into reliable production environments with maintainability, security, error handling, traceability, testing, and operational support in mind. Observe usage, diagnose issues, and improve solutions based on feedback.

Scale what works:
Turn lessons from program-specific implementations into reusable platform capabilities, technical patterns, and components. Surface gaps between platform capabilities and real-world needs and feed those insights back to product and engineering teams.

Communicate clearly:
Explain technical options, feasibility, tradeoffs, and constraints to technical and non-technical audiences. Support demonstrations, walkthroughs, and hands-on sessions with users and stakeholders.

Qualifications

Required

3 years of professional software engineering experience, including meaningful full-stack development experience.

Additional Qualifications

Strong programming skills and experience building modern web applications with JavaScript/TypeScript or comparable technologies.
Experience with relational databases, APIs, external services, and production software delivery.
Ability to work directly with users and stakeholders to understand problems and translate them into technical solutions.
Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts and tradeoffs to non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated ability to deliver iteratively when requirements are incomplete or changing.
Experience with version control, code review, testing, and collaborative software development practices.

Preferred

Client-facing, embedded, consulting, or Forward Deployed Engineering experience.
Experience integrating LLM capabilities into applications, including summarization, structured extraction, classification, evaluation, or AI-enabled workflows.
Experience building multi-step workflows, stateful applications, or human-in-the-loop processes.
Experience with case management, workflow, grant management, or program management systems.
Cloud-native development, CI/CD, automated testing, observability, or production operations experience.
Experience with government technology environments, sensitive data, data governance, privacy, or responsible AI.
Interest or experience in health, public health, rural health, or public-sector program delivery.
Professional use of AI-assisted software engineering tools.

How You’ll Work And What Success Looks Like

This role sits at the intersection of engineering, users, and real-world operations. You will not simply receive a backlog of fully defined requirements. You will work with stakeholders to understand what they are trying to accomplish, determine the right technical approach, and move from idea to working software. Some problems will require traditional engineering; others may benefit from workflow automation, data integration, or AI.

In your first six months, success means developing a strong understanding of the program and its users, building trusted working relationships, and delivering production capabilities that address meaningful operational needs. Over your first year, you will help turn lessons from individual implementations into reusable capabilities and engineering patterns that make future delivery faster and more consistent.

Technology environment:
JavaScript/TypeScript-based front-end development, server-side application development, relational databases, RESTful APIs, cloud services, workflow and state management, LLM-enabled application patterns, version control, CI/CD, and automated testing. Strong engineering fundamentals and the ability to learn new technologies matter more than matching every tool in the stack.

Working at ICF

ICF is a global advisory and technology services provider, but we’re not your typical consultants. We combine unmatched expertise with cutting-edge technology to help clients solve their most complex challenges, navigate change, and shape the future.

We can only solve the world's toughest challenges by building a workplace that allows everyone to thrive. We are an equal opportunity employer. Together, our employees are empowered to share their expertise and collaborate with others to achieve personal and professional goals. For more information, please read our EEO policy.

We will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.

Work Authorization and Sponsorship

All candidates must be authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for new H-1B visa sponsorship by ICF. Candidates who currently hold valid work authorization may be considered for a change of employer petition, subject to company policy and applicable immigration requirements.

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About Beneficial Deployments

Beneficial Deployments ensures AI reaches and benefits the communities that need it most. We partner with nonprofits, foundations, and mission-driven organizations to deploy Claude in education, global health, economic mobility, and life sciences — focusing on raising the floor for those who need it most.

About The Role

We're looking for an Applied AI Architect to join Beneficial Deployments, focused on helping nonprofits and foundations get real value from Claude. You'll be the technical lead for a portfolio of partners, working alongside our Account Executives from first conversation through deployment. You'll help partners find where Claude makes a real difference to their mission and their operations, design solutions that fit their budgets, data and teams, and turn early pilots into lasting adoption. What works for one partner becomes something the whole sector can use.

Responsibilities

Serve as the primary technical advisor to a portfolio of nonprofit partners from discovery through deployment, turning their priorities into scoped use cases with clear measures of success.
Partner with Account Executives on account plans, discovery and technical evaluation.
Design and demo solutions with Claude, the API and Claude Code across program delivery, fundraising, operations and data analysis.
Guide partners through security review, data governance and procurement.
Run workshops and trainings that build AI fluency across partner teams.
Build reusable assets (reference designs, connectors, prompt and eval templates) so one partner's work helps the next.
Spot patterns across partners, bring field insight back to Product and Research, and help partners measure what changed.
Travel to partner sites for workshops, technical deep dives and relationship building.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You Have

3+ years in customer-facing technical roles such as solutions architecture, sales engineering, forward-deployed engineering or technical consulting.
A track record of getting lean, skeptical or slow-moving teams to adopt technology and keep using it, including working through how they buy and govern it.
Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs: you have built and evaluated working prototypes or agents, and can guide a partner's own engineers on architecture and evals. You don't need to write production code.
Clear written and spoken communication across a broad audience. The ability to explain technical tradeoffs to program leads, operations staff and executives.
Patience with long buying cycles, a knack for knowing how to make them go smoothly, and real care for public benefit.
A track record of agency and autonomy: you spot what needs doing before anyone asks, agree that it matters, drive it to a finished result and know when to pull others in.
Comfort operating in ambiguity: you bring clarity to fuzzy problems, wear multiple hats and do whatever it takes to further the mission.
Bonus if you've worked in a sales team, or with or at nonprofits, foundations or other mission-driven organizations.

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role.

$240,000—$315,000 USD

Logistics

Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study:
A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience:
Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy:
Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship:
We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California:
We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.
Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us.
To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How We're Different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.
